tools.name: Get repository development environment secret
tools.description: Gets metadata (name, creation/update timestamps) for a specific, existing development environment secret (Codespaces secret) in a repository, without exposing its value.

tools.name: Get repository attestations

tools.name: Get repository clones

tools.name: Get repository content

tools.description: Lists all custom deployment protection rule integrations for a repository environment; the `environment_name` must be URL-encoded.

tools.name: List environments
tools.description: Retrieves all deployment environments for a specified repository, which are used to configure protection rules and secrets for different software lifecycle stages.

tools.name: List environment secrets
tools.description: Lists the names and metadata (not values) of secrets for a specified, existing environment within an existing GitHub repository.

tools.name: List environment variables
tools.description: Lists all environment variables, which are plaintext key-value pairs for GitHub Actions workflows, for a specified environment within a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List events for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists public events for the specified GitHub user, or private events if authenticated as that user, in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: List events received by the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists events a specific GitHub user received from followed users and watched repositories; returns private events if authenticated for `username`, otherwise public.

tools.name: List followers of a user
tools.description: Lists followers for a specified, existing GitHub user.

tools.name: List followers of the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists users following the authenticated GitHub user, returning an empty list if the user has no followers.

tools.name: List forks
tools.description: Lists forks for a specified repository, which must exist, with options for sorting and pagination.

tools.name: List gist comments
tools.description: Lists comments for a specified GitHub Gist.

tools.name: List gist commits
tools.description: Lists all commits for a specified gist.

tools.name: List gist forks
tools.description: Lists all forks for a given GitHub gist ID.

tools.name: List gists for a user
tools.description: _lists public gists for a specified GitHub user._

tools.name: List gists for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists gists for the authenticated user, with optional filtering by update time and pagination.

tools.name: List github actions caches for a repository
tools.description: Lists GitHub Actions caches for a repository, with options to filter by Git reference or cache key, and to sort and paginate results.

tools.name: List GitHub Pages builds
tools.description: Lists GitHub Pages builds for a repository; GitHub Pages must be enabled on the repository for builds to be listed.

tools.name: Get all gitignore templates
tools.description: Retrieves all available .gitignore template names from GitHub (e.g., 'Python', 'Node', 'Java'), used for generating .gitignore files.

tools.name: List global security advisories
tools.description: Lists GitHub's global security advisories, filterable by various attributes including ID, type, ecosystem, severity, and dates.

tools.name: List GPG keys for a user
tools.description: Tool to list GPG keys for a GitHub user. Use when you need to fetch the public GPG keys associated with a specific GitHub user account.

tools.name: List installation requests for the authenticated app
tools.description: Lists pending installation requests made by users or organizations for the authenticated GitHub App.

tools.name: List instances of a code scanning alert
tools.description: Lists all instances of a specific code scanning alert, optionally filtered by Git ref; requires code scanning to be enabled on the repository.

tools.name: List issue comments
tools.description: Lists comments for a specified issue in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List issue comments for a repository
tools.description: Lists issue comments, including those on pull requests, for an accessible repository.

tools.name: List issue dependencies blocked by
tools.description: Tool to list dependencies an issue is blocked by. Use when you need to retrieve all issues that are blocking a specific issue from being closed or completed.

tools.name: List issue dependencies blocking
tools.description: Tool to list dependencies an issue is blocking. Use when you need to see which issues are blocked by a specific issue.

tools.name: List issue events
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all events for a specific issue within a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List issue events for a repository
tools.description: Lists all issue events (e.g., closed, reopened, assigned) for a specified repository.

tools.name: List issues for user
tools.description: Lists GitHub issues for the authenticated user across visible repositories, with filtering by user relationship, state, labels, an ISO 8601 `since` timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ), and sorting options; pull requests are typically included.

tools.name: List issue types
tools.description: List all issue types configured for a GitHub organization. Requires read:org scope for OAuth tokens.

tools.name: List jobs for a workflow run
tools.description: Lists jobs for a specific workflow run in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List jobs for a workflow run attempt
tools.description: Lists jobs, including details like ID, status, and steps, for a specific attempt of a GitHub Actions workflow run.

tools.name: List labels for an issue
tools.description: Lists all labels for a specified issue in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List labels for a repository
tools.description: Retrieves all labels for a specified, existing GitHub repository.

tools.name: List labels for a self-hosted runner for a repository
tools.description: Lists all labels assigned to a specific self-hosted runner registered with the given repository.

tools.name: List labels for issues in a milestone
tools.description: Lists all labels for issues within a specific milestone in a repository.

tools.name: List labels for a self-hosted runner for an organization
tools.description: Lists all labels assigned to a specific self-hosted runner within a GitHub organization, which are used to route workflows.

tools.name: List Licenses (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to fetch all known open source licenses using GitHub's GraphQL API. Use when you need to retrieve the complete list of licenses that can be applied to repositories.

tools.name: List machine types for a codespace
tools.description: Lists available machine types for a specific, accessible codespace, enabling it to be transitioned to a new hardware configuration.

tools.name: List matching references
tools.description: Lists all Git references (branches or tags) in a repository that start with the provided partial reference path (e.g., `heads/my-feature` or `tags/v1.2`).

tools.name: List milestones
tools.description: Lists milestones, which track progress for groups of issues and pull requests, for an existing repository, allowing filtering by state and sorting.

tools.name: List notifications for authenticated user
tools.description: Tool to list notification threads for the authenticated user with efficient polling support. Use when you need to fetch the user's GitHub notification inbox with filters like unread/participating/since. Returns notification threads plus polling headers (Last-Modified, ETag, X-Poll-Interval) for efficient polling. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires a Personal Access Token (classic) with 'notifications' or 'repo' scope. It does NOT work with GitHub App tokens or fine-grained personal access tokens. If the token type is incompatible, a clear error message will be returned.

tools.name: List notifications for the authenticated user (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use GITHUB_LIST_NOTIFICATIONS instead. Lists notifications for the authenticated user, sorted by most recent update, with filtering and pagination options.

tools.name: List org level codespaces secrets
tools.description: Lists all Codespaces secrets available for a specified organization, which must exist.

tools.name: List organization events for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists public events in a specified GitHub organization for the authenticated user's organization dashboard. Returns activities like repository pushes, pull requests, issues, forks, and other public events within the organization. The authenticated user must be a member of the organization to see events.

tools.name: List organization members
tools.description: Lists public and concealed members of a GitHub organization; viewing concealed members requires authenticated user to be an organization member.

tools.name: List organization memberships for authenticated user
tools.description: List organization memberships for authenticated user

tools.name: List organization projects
tools.description: Lists projects (V2) for a specified GitHub organization, with optional search query and cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: List organization repositories
tools.description: Retrieves a list of repositories for a specified GitHub organization, allowing filtering by type and sorting.

tools.name: Get all organization roles for an organization
tools.description: Lists all custom organization roles for an existing GitHub organization.

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: Lists GitHub organizations for the authenticated user, sorted by ID in ascending order.

tools.name: List organization secrets
tools.description: Lists GitHub Actions secrets available for a specified organization.

tools.name: List organizations for a user
tools.description: Lists public organizations for a specified GitHub user; the `username` must be a valid GitHub handle.

tools.name: List organizations for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists organizations the authenticated GitHub user is a member of, returning details for each organization.

tools.name: List organization variables
tools.description: Lists all GitHub Actions variables for a specified organization.

tools.name: List organization webhooks
tools.description: Lists all webhooks for a specified GitHub organization; the organization must exist.

tools.name: List organization fine-grained permissions
tools.description: Lists all fine-grained permissions available in a GitHub organization for use in custom organization roles. These permissions define granular access controls that can be combined when creating custom roles. Note: This endpoint requires GitHub Enterprise Cloud with the custom organization roles feature enabled. The authenticated user must be an administrator or have the 'read_organization_custom_org_role' permission.

tools.name: List organization issues assigned to the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists issues for the authenticated user within a specified GitHub organization, with options to filter by involvement type, state, labels, and to sort results.

tools.name: List package versions for an organization package
tools.description: Lists all versions for a specified package, if it exists and is owned by the given GitHub organization.

tools.name: List organization project view items
tools.description: Tool to list items for an organization project view. Use when you need to retrieve all items from a specific view within a GitHub organization's Projects V2 project. Returns a list of project items with their content, metadata, and field values.

tools.name: List organization repositories with Github Actions enabled
tools.description: Lists the selected repositories that are enabled for GitHub Actions in an organization. This endpoint only returns results when the organization's 'enabled_repositories' permission policy is configured to 'selected'. Requires admin:org scope and organization admin permissions.

tools.name: List org resource access tokens
tools.description: Lists approved fine-grained personal access tokens (PATs) with access to resources in a GitHub organization, optionally filtering by owner, repository, permissions, or last usage time. AUTHENTICATION REQUIREMENT: This endpoint requires GitHub App authentication with 'Personal access tokens' organization permissions (read). Standard personal access tokens CANNOT use this endpoint. The GitHub App must also have access to the organization.

tools.name: List org resources with personal tokens
tools.description: Lists requests from organization members to access organization resources with fine-grained personal access tokens (pending, approved, or denied). Note: This endpoint requires GitHub App authentication with 'organization_personal_access_token_requests:read' permissions; it cannot be used with personal access tokens.

tools.name: List organization Dependabot secrets without values
tools.description: Lists all Dependabot secrets (metadata like names, creation/update timestamps, but not their encrypted values) for a specified organization, which must exist.

tools.name: List outside collaborators for an organization
tools.description: Lists outside collaborators for a GitHub organization, with options to filter (e.g., by 2FA status) and paginate results.

tools.name: List owned package versions
tools.description: Lists all versions for an existing package owned by the authenticated user, identified by its type and name.

tools.name: List packages for an organization
tools.description: Lists GitHub Packages for an organization, noting specific interpretations for package_type and visibility parameters.

tools.name: List packages for a user
tools.description: Lists packages for a specified GitHub user, filterable by package type and visibility.

tools.name: List packages for the authenticated user's namespace
tools.description: Lists packages of a specific type and visibility within the authenticated user's namespace on GitHub.

tools.name: List package versions for a package owned by a user
tools.description: Lists all versions of a public package owned by a specific GitHub user, identified by package type, package name, and username.

tools.name: List pending team invitations
tools.description: Lists all pending membership invitations for a specified team within an organization. The authenticated user must be an organization member with the read:org scope. The response includes invitation details such as the invitee's login/email, the role they're being invited to, and who sent the invitation. The 'role' field indicates the type of invitation: - 'direct_member': Regular organization member - 'admin': Organization administrator - 'billing_manager': Billing manager role - 'hiring_manager': Hiring manager role - 'reinstate': Reinstating a previous member Note: If the invitee is not a GitHub member, the 'login' field will be null and only the 'email' field will be populated.

tools.name: List project cards (Classic - Deprecated)
tools.description: Lists all project cards for a given column_id in GitHub Projects (classic). DEPRECATION NOTICE: GitHub Projects (classic) and its REST API were sunset on April 1, 2025. This action will return 404 for most requests on GitHub.com. However, it may still work on GitHub Enterprise Server instances where classic projects are enabled. For new projects, use GitHub Projects V2 which uses the GraphQL API instead. See: https://github.blog/changelog/2024-05-23-sunset-notice-projects-classic/ Returns a list of project cards including: id, node_id, url, note (or null for linked cards), creator info, content_url (for issue/PR cards), column_url, project_url, timestamps, and archived status.

tools.name: List project collaborators (classic)
tools.description: Lists collaborators for a GitHub Project (classic) by project ID. IMPORTANT: This action uses the Projects (classic) REST API which was sunset on April 1, 2025 for GitHub.com. The API may still be available on GitHub Enterprise Server versions before 3.17. For GitHub.com users: GitHub Projects (classic) has been replaced by the new Projects experience. The new Projects does not have a REST API for listing collaborators - use the GitHub web interface to manage project collaborators instead. You must be an organization owner or a project admin to list collaborators.

tools.name: List project columns
tools.description: Lists all of a GitHub project's columns (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress'); project_id must identify a valid, accessible project. Note: This action uses GitHub's Projects (classic) REST API. The Projects (classic) API was sunset on April 1, 2025. This action will return an empty columns list with an informative message for projects that no longer exist or when the API returns 404.

tools.name: List project fields for user
tools.description: Tool to list all fields in a GitHub Projects V2 project for a specific user. Use when you need to see available fields in a project.

tools.name: List project items for user
tools.description: Tool to list items for a user-owned GitHub project. Use when you need to retrieve all items (issues, pull requests, draft issues) from a specific project belonging to a user.

tools.name: List items for user project view
tools.description: Tool to list items for a user's GitHub Projects (v2) view. Use when you need to retrieve items from a specific view of a user's project. Supports pagination and field filtering.

tools.name: List public email addresses for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists the public email addresses for the authenticated user.

tools.name: List public events
tools.description: Lists public GitHub events, which may be delayed by up to 5 minutes, with support for pagination.

tools.name: List public events for a network of repositories
tools.description: Retrieves public events (up to 90 days old, newest first) for a GitHub repository network, including the repository and its forks.

tools.name: List public events for a user
tools.description: Retrieves a list of public events for a specified GitHub user, in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: List public events received by a user
tools.description: Lists public events for a specified GitHub user (e.g., activities in repositories they watch or are involved in); the target user's profile must be public, and if blocked by the authenticated user, a 404 error is returned.

tools.name: List public gists
tools.description: Lists public gists from GitHub, optionally filtering by a 'since' timestamp and supporting pagination; results are generally newest first.

tools.name: List public keys for a user
tools.description: Lists the verified public SSH keys for a specified GitHub user.

tools.name: List public organization events
tools.description: Lists public events for a specified GitHub organization, which must exist. This action retrieves the events that are publicly accessible for the organization specified. It returns a paginated list of events with details about each event.

tools.name: List public organization members
tools.description: Lists users who have publicly declared their membership in a specified, existing GitHub organization.

tools.name: List public repositories
tools.description: Lists all public repositories on GitHub; use the `since` parameter with a repository ID from a previous result for pagination.

tools.name: List pull requests
tools.description: Lists pull requests for a GitHub repository. REQUIRES 'owner' AND 'repo' parameters - both are MANDATORY and must be provided in every call. Does NOT support filtering by assignee or date range - use GITHUB_FIND_PULL_REQUESTS instead for searching PRs by assignee, author, or across multiple repositories.

tools.name: List pull requests associated with a commit
tools.description: Lists pull requests for a commit; returns merged PRs that introduced the commit if on the default branch, or open PRs including the commit if on other branches.

tools.name: List pull requests files
tools.description: Lists all files (including additions, modifications, and removals) associated with a specific pull request in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List reactions for a commit comment
tools.description: Lists reactions for a specific commit comment; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: List reactions for an issue
tools.description: Lists reactions for a specific, existing issue within an accessible GitHub repository, optionally filtering by content type.

tools.name: List reactions for an issue comment
tools.description: Lists reactions for a specific issue comment in a GitHub repository, optionally filtering by content type.

tools.name: List reactions for a pull request review comment
tools.description: Lists reactions for a pull request review comment in a repository, optionally filtering by reaction type.

tools.name: List reactions for a release
tools.description: Lists all reactions, or optionally filters reactions by a specific content type, for a given GitHub release.

tools.name: List reactions for a team discussion
tools.description: Lists reactions for an existing team discussion within an organization. This endpoint allows you to retrieve all reactions (emoji responses) made to a specific team discussion. You can optionally filter by reaction type. Note: OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:discussion` scope to use this endpoint.

tools.name: List reactions for a team discussion comment
tools.description: Lists reactions for a specific comment in a team discussion within an organization, optionally filtering by content type.

tools.name: List release assets
tools.description: Lists assets (e.g., compiled binaries, source code archives) for a specific GitHub release, identified by `release_id` which must be valid for an existing release in the repository.

tools.name: List releases
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all releases (published, draft, and prerelease) for a specified repository.

tools.name: List repo access by token
tools.description: Lists repositories in an organization that a fine-grained personal access token has requested access to. Only GitHub Apps can use this endpoint. Requires 'Personal access token requests' organization permissions (read).

tools.name: List repo codespaces for authenticated user
tools.description: Lists Codespaces the authenticated user can access within a specified, existing repository.

tools.name: List repo dev container configs for user
tools.description: Lists the `devcontainer.json` configurations available in a specified repository for use with GitHub Codespaces.

tools.name: List authenticated user's repository invitations
tools.description: Lists all pending repository invitations for the authenticated user.

tools.name: List repository notifications for the authenticated user
tools.description: Retrieves notifications for the authenticated user from a specified repository, to which the user must have access.

tools.name: List repo secrets without values
tools.description: Lists all Codespaces secrets available in a specific repository, without their encrypted values.

tools.name: List repos accessible to app installation
tools.description: Lists repositories a GitHub App installation can access. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires a GitHub App installation access token (ghs_* prefix) for authentication. OAuth/user access tokens (gho_*) or personal access tokens are not supported and will result in a 403 Forbidden error. Returns 'total_count' and 'repositories' array with pagination support.

tools.name: List repositories for a user
tools.description: Lists public repositories for a specified GitHub user, who must have an existing account.

tools.name: List repositories for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists repositories for the authenticated user; using 'type' with 'visibility' or 'affiliation' API parameters (not in this model) can cause a 422 error.

tools.name: List repositories starred by a user
tools.description: Lists repositories a valid and existing GitHub user has starred.

tools.name: List repositories starred by the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists repositories the authenticated user has starred, optionally sorted and paginated, including star creation timestamps via 'application/vnd.github.star+json' media type.

tools.name: List repositories watched by a user
tools.description: Lists repositories a given GitHub user is watching; the username must be a valid and existing GitHub user handle.

tools.name: List repositories watched by the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists repositories the authenticated user is watching (subscribed to for notifications). This action retrieves a list of repositories that the authenticated user is currently watching. It allows the user to manage their watched repositories effectively.

tools.name: List repos with ghactions cache usage
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of GitHub Actions cache usage statistics for repositories within an existing GitHub organization.

tools.name: List repository activities
tools.description: Lists activities for a GitHub repository, ensuring the repository exists and is accessible.

tools.name: Get all autolinks of a repository
tools.description: Retrieves all autolinks (e.g., for JIRA issues) configured for a repository; requires admin permissions on the repository.

tools.name: List repository collaborators
tools.description: Lists collaborators for a specified repository, provided it exists and is accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: List repository contributors
tools.description: Lists contributors to a specified repository, sorted by number of contributions in descending order; the repository must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: List repository events
tools.description: Lists chronological events (e.g., code pushes, issue activities, PR actions, forks) for a specified, existing GitHub repository.

tools.name: List repository invitations
tools.description: Retrieves all pending (unaccepted or undeclined) collaboration invitations for a specified GitHub repository.

tools.name: List repository issues
tools.description: Lists issues (including pull requests) from a GitHub repository. Requires BOTH 'owner' AND 'repo' parameters (e.g., owner='octocat', repo='Hello-World' for github.com/octocat/Hello-World).

tools.name: List repository languages
tools.description: Lists the programming languages used in a GitHub repository, returning a byte count for each language.

tools.name: List repository organization secrets
tools.description: Lists names of organization-level secrets shared with the specified repository; actual secret values are not returned and visibility depends on token access.

tools.name: List repository organization variables
tools.description: Lists organization-level variables that are shared with a specific repository. The repository must belong to an organization (not a personal account).

tools.name: List repository projects
tools.description: Lists Projects (classic) associated with a specific repository. Note: This action lists GitHub Projects (classic), which is GitHub's legacy project management feature. If the repository has Projects (classic) disabled or uses the newer Projects V2, this will return an empty list. Most modern repositories use Projects V2 (GraphQL API) instead of Projects (classic).

tools.name: Get all repository rulesets
tools.description: Retrieves all rulesets for a GitHub repository, which define conditions and actions for repository interactions (e.g., branch protections).

tools.name: List repository rule suites
tools.description: Lists rule suite evaluations for a repository, allowing filtering by ref (non-wildcard), time period, actor, and result.

tools.name: List repository secrets
tools.description: Lists metadata for all secrets in a GitHub repository, excluding their encrypted values.

tools.name: List repository secrets without decrypting
tools.description: Lists metadata (e.g., name, creation/update dates) for all Dependabot secrets in a repository; secret values are not included.

tools.name: List repository security advisories
tools.description: Tool to list security advisories for a repository. Use when you need to retrieve security advisories published for a specific repository, optionally filtered by state.

tools.name: List repository tags
tools.description: Lists tags for a specified GitHub repository.

tools.name: List repository teams
tools.description: Lists all teams with explicit permission to access the specified repository; the repository must exist.

tools.name: Get all repository topics
tools.description: Retrieves all topics for a specified, existing, and accessible repository.

tools.name: List repository variables
tools.description: Lists plain text key-value variables for GitHub Actions workflows within a specific, accessible repository.

tools.name: List repository webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves a list of webhooks for a repository, which must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: List repository workflows
tools.description: Lists all GitHub Actions workflows for a specified repository, which must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: Get all requested reviewers for a pull request
tools.description: Gets all users and teams requested to review a specific pull request in a repository.

tools.name: List review comments in a repository
tools.description: Lists all review comments on all pull requests within a specified repository.

tools.name: List review comments on a pull request
tools.description: Lists all review comments on a specific pull request within a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List reviews for a pull request
tools.description: Lists submitted reviews chronologically for a specific pull request within a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List runner applications for an organization
tools.description: Lists downloadable GitHub Actions runner application binaries for setting up self-hosted runners in a GitHub organization. Returns download URLs and checksums for various OS/architecture combinations (linux/win/osx on x64/arm/arm64). Requires admin:org scope or fine-grained 'Self-hosted runners' read permission.

tools.name: List runner applications for a repository
tools.description: Lists available self-hosted runner application binaries for a specific repository, including their OS, architecture, and download URL.

tools.name: List secret scanning alerts for a repository
tools.description: List secret scanning alerts for a GitHub repository using first-party detections. Use this to retrieve detected secrets with filtering by state, type, resolution, and validity. Supports optional hiding of secret literals for security.

tools.name: List secrets for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists all Codespaces secrets accessible to the authenticated user for use within GitHub Codespaces.

tools.name: List security advisories (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to list GitHub Security Advisories using the GraphQL API. Use when you need to query security vulnerabilities and malware advisories from the GitHub Advisory Database with advanced filtering and pagination options.

tools.name: List security vulnerabilities
tools.description: Query software vulnerabilities documented by GitHub Security Advisories using GraphQL. Use this to find security issues in packages across ecosystems like npm, pip, maven, etc.

tools.name: List selected repositories for a Codespaces organization secret
tools.description: Lists repositories that have been granted access to a Codespaces organization secret. Returns all repositories that have been selected when the visibility for repository access to a Codespaces secret is set to 'selected'. Requires admin:org scope and admin access to the organization. Note: This endpoint only returns results when the secret's visibility is set to 'selected'. Secrets with visibility 'all' or 'private' do not have specific repository selections.

tools.name: List selected repositories for a user secret
tools.description: Lists repositories that have access to the specified user Codespaces secret. This endpoint retrieves all repositories that the authenticated user has granted access to for a specific user-level Codespaces secret. The secret must already exist for this endpoint to work. Use 'list_secrets_for_the_authenticated_user' to discover available secrets first. Note: The authenticated user must have Codespaces access enabled. OAuth tokens and personal access tokens require the 'codespace' or 'codespace:secrets' scope.

tools.name: List selected repos for secret access
tools.description: Lists repositories within a specified organization that have been granted access to a particular Dependabot secret. Note: This endpoint only returns results when the secret's visibility is set to 'selected'. Secrets with visibility 'all' or 'private' do not have specific repository selections. Requires 'admin:org' scope and the user must have admin access to the organization.

tools.name: List selected repositories for an organization variable
tools.description: Lists repositories in an organization that can access a specific organization variable; supports pagination and returns an empty list if no repositories have been granted access. Note: This endpoint only works for variables with visibility set to 'selected' - attempting to use it on variables with 'all' or 'private' visibility will result in a 409 Conflict error.

tools.name: List self hosted runners for an organization
tools.description: Lists self-hosted runners for a GitHub organization, optionally filtering by name and paginating results, providing details for each runner such as OS, status, and labels.

tools.name: List self hosted runners for a repository
tools.description: Lists all self-hosted runners configured for a repository.

tools.name: List social accounts for a user
tools.description: Lists social media accounts publicly linked to an existing GitHub user's profile.

tools.name: List social accounts for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists all social media accounts linked to the authenticated user's GitHub profile. This action retrieves the social media accounts associated with the user's GitHub profile, allowing for easy management and visibility of connected accounts. The results include accounts such as Twitter, LinkedIn, and other platforms linked to the GitHub profile.

tools.name: List Sponsorable Users and Organizations
tools.description: Tool to list users and organizations who can be sponsored via GitHub Sponsors. Use when you need to discover sponsorable entities with optional filtering by dependency ecosystem.

tools.name: List SSH signing keys for user
tools.description: Lists the public SSH signing keys for a specified GitHub user.

tools.name: List stargazers
tools.description: Lists users who have starred the specified GitHub repository, which must exist.

tools.name: List starred gists
tools.description: Retrieves a list of gists starred by the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get all status check contexts
tools.description: Fetches all required status check contexts for a protected branch; returns an empty list if the branch isn't protected or has no required checks.

tools.name: List sub-issues for an issue
tools.description: Tool to list sub-issues for a specific GitHub issue. Use when you need to retrieve all sub-issues associated with a parent issue, supporting pagination for large hierarchies.

tools.name: List marketplace subscriptions for authenticated user
tools.description: Tool to list GitHub Marketplace subscriptions for the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve active marketplace app subscriptions including billing details, plan information, and trial status. Returns subscription information with account, plan, billing cycle, and pricing details.

tools.name: List stubbed subscriptions for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists the authenticated user's stubbed (test/example data, not live) GitHub Marketplace subscriptions, useful for development or testing.

tools.name: List tag protection states for a repository
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Lists tag protection rules for a repository. This API was sunset on August 30, 2024. Use GITHUB_GET_ALL_REPOSITORY_RULESETS instead to view tag protection rules via repository rulesets.

tools.name: List team members
tools.description: Lists members of a specific team within an organization, including members of child teams.

tools.name: List team projects
tools.description: Lists GitHub projects accessible to a specific team within an organization.

tools.name: List team repositories
tools.description: Lists repositories accessible to a specific team within a GitHub organization. Returns a list of repositories that the specified team has access to, including the team's permission level (admin, maintain, push, triage, pull) for each repository. Requires read:org scope and membership in the organization to access team data.

tools.name: List teams
tools.description: Lists teams for a specified GitHub organization.

tools.name: List teams for the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists all teams across all organizations to which the authenticated user belongs, supporting pagination.

tools.name: List teams assigned to an organization role
tools.description: Lists teams assigned to a specific role within a GitHub organization. This endpoint requires organization administrator privileges. Use this to audit which teams have been granted specific organization-level permissions through roles. Note: Organization roles is a feature for enterprise-level GitHub organizations.

tools.name: List the people a user follows
tools.description: Lists GitHub users that a valid GitHub `username` is following, supporting pagination.

tools.name: List people the authenticated user follows
tools.description: Lists people the authenticated user follows.

tools.name: List timeline events for an issue
tools.description: Lists chronological events (e.g., comments, commits, label changes) for a specific issue in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List token access repositories
tools.description: Lists repositories in an organization that a fine-grained personal access token has access to. Requires organization admin permissions or 'Personal access tokens' organization read permission. Only GitHub Apps can use this endpoint.

tools.name: List user projects
tools.description: Retrieves a list of projects for a specified GitHub user, optionally filtering by state and supporting pagination; the username must be a valid GitHub handle. Note: This action uses GitHub's Projects V2 GraphQL API. The legacy Projects V1 REST API has been sunset by GitHub.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Retrieves all GitHub users (individuals and organizations) in chronological order of their sign-up date.

tools.name: List users blocked by an organization
tools.description: Lists users blocked by a specified GitHub organization.

tools.name: List users blocked by the authenticated user
tools.description: Lists users blocked by the authenticated user, returning an empty list if no users are blocked.

tools.name: List users assigned org role
tools.description: Lists users assigned to a specific role within a GitHub organization.

tools.name: List watchers
tools.description: Retrieves a list of users watching a specific repository; the repository must be accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: List workflow run artifacts
tools.description: Lists artifacts (e.g., build outputs, test results) for a specific workflow run in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: List workflow runs for a repository
tools.description: Lists workflow runs for a repository, allowing filtering by actor, branch, event, status, creation date, check suite ID, or head SHA; the repository must exist and be accessible.

tools.name: List workflow runs for a workflow
tools.description: Lists runs for a specified, existing workflow (identified by ID or filename like `main.yml`) in a GitHub repository, with filtering options.

tools.name: Lock an issue
tools.description: Locks an existing GitHub issue's conversation, preventing further comments; an optional reason can be specified.

tools.name: Lookup Enterprise Administrator Invitation
tools.description: Tool to look up a pending enterprise administrator invitation by invitee, enterprise, and role. Use when you need to check if a specific user has a pending invitation to become an enterprise administrator.

tools.name: Lookup GitHub Resource
tools.description: Tool to lookup a GitHub resource by its URL. Use when you need to identify or retrieve information about a GitHub resource from its URL.

tools.name: Lookup nodes by IDs
tools.description: Tool to lookup GitHub nodes by their global node IDs. Use when you need to retrieve multiple objects by their IDs in a single batch query.

tools.name: Lookup Organization (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to lookup a GitHub organization by login using GraphQL. Use when you need organization information via GraphQL API.

tools.name: Look Up Topic by Name
tools.description: Tool to look up a GitHub topic by name using GraphQL. Use when you need to find information about a specific GitHub topic including its popularity (stargazer count) and related topics.

tools.name: Manage access control for organization codespaces
tools.description: Sets the Codespaces access control policy for a GitHub organization, determining which members can use them. This endpoint requires admin permissions on the organization. The API returns HTTP 204 No Content on success.

tools.name: Manage custom properties for org repos
tools.description: Creates or updates values for an organization's predefined custom properties across multiple repositories (up to 30).

tools.name: List selected repositories for a GitHub Actions organization secret
tools.description: Lists repositories within an organization that have been explicitly granted access to a specific GitHub Actions organization secret. Returns all repositories that have been selected when the visibility for repository access to an Actions secret is set to 'selected'. Requires admin:org scope and admin access to the organization. Note: This endpoint only returns results when the secret's visibility is set to 'selected'. Secrets with visibility 'all' or 'private' do not have specific repository selections.

tools.name: Map a commit author
tools.description: Updates Git author information (name and/or email) for an `author_id` obtained during a repository import, to correctly attribute commits. NOTE: This endpoint has been deprecated by GitHub as of April 12, 2024, and is no longer available. The Source Imports REST API has been retired due to very low usage levels. Please use the GitHub Importer tool at https://github.com/new/import for repository imports.

tools.name: Mark a thread as done
tools.description: Marks the GitHub notification thread (identified by `thread_id`) as done or read for the authenticated user, effectively archiving it.

tools.name: Mark a thread as read
tools.description: Marks an existing GitHub notification thread, identified by its `thread_id`, as read.

tools.name: Mark notifications as read
tools.description: Marks notifications as read or unread, optionally for those updated at or before a `last_read_at` timestamp.

tools.name: Mark repository notifications as read
tools.description: Marks notifications in a repository as read; if 'last_read_at' is specified, notifications updated after this timestamp are not marked as read.

tools.name: Merge a branch
tools.description: Merges a head branch or commit SHA into a base branch in a repository; fails if there are merge conflicts requiring manual resolution.

tools.name: Merge a pull request
tools.description: Merges an open and mergeable pull request in a repository. A 405 error can occur for multiple reasons: (1) The PR is still in draft mode - convert it to ready-for-review first using GITHUB_UPDATE_A_PULL_REQUEST. (2) Branch protection rules are not satisfied - check for required approving reviews, status checks, or other repository rules that must be met before merging. (3) The base branch has been modified since the PR was last synced - update the PR branch first using GITHUB_UPDATE_A_PULL_REQUEST_BRANCH.

tools.name: Move a project card (Classic - Deprecated)
tools.description: Moves a project card to a specified position within a column (GitHub Classic Projects). DEPRECATION NOTICE: GitHub Projects (classic) and its REST API were sunset on April 1, 2025. This action will return 404 for most requests on GitHub.com. It may still work on GitHub Enterprise Server instances where classic projects remain enabled. For new projects, use GitHub Projects V2 which uses the GraphQL API instead. See: https://github.blog/changelog/2024-05-23-sunset-notice-projects-classic/ On success, the API returns HTTP 201 with an empty body, indicating the card was moved.

tools.name: Move a project column (Classic - Deprecated)
tools.description: Moves a column within a GitHub project (classic) to a new position. DEPRECATION NOTICE: GitHub Classic Projects (V1) and its REST API were sunset on April 1, 2025. This action will return a 404 error on GitHub.com. For new projects, use GitHub Projects V2 which uses the GraphQL API instead. The `position` parameter can be: - 'first': Move the column to the beginning of the project - 'last': Move the column to the end of the project - 'after:<column_id>': Place the column after the specified column (e.g., 'after:67890') See: https://github.blog/changelog/2024-05-23-sunset-notice-projects-classic/

tools.name: Ping an organization webhook
tools.description: Sends a 'ping' event to a specified, existing organization webhook to test its configuration and ensure it correctly receives events.

tools.name: Ping a repository webhook
tools.description: Pings an existing webhook on a repository to test its configuration and reachability by GitHub.

tools.name: Privately report a security vulnerability
tools.description: Privately reports a security vulnerability to a repository's maintainers. IMPORTANT: You cannot report vulnerabilities to repositories you own - this API is for third-party security researchers to report to other repositories. The target repository must have private vulnerability reporting enabled. Specify EITHER `severity` OR `cvss_vector_string`, but not both.

tools.name: Publish Sponsors Tier (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to publish a draft GitHub Sponsors tier using GraphQL. Use when you need to make a draft sponsors tier visible to potential sponsors. The tier must already exist in draft status.

tools.name: Redeliver a delivery for an organization webhook
tools.description: Redelivers a specific webhook delivery for a webhook within an organization, to resend an event that previously failed or was not processed.

tools.name: Redeliver a delivery for a repository webhook
tools.description: Redelivers a specific, previously made webhook delivery (`delivery_id`) for a repository's webhook (`hook_id`).

tools.name: Remove a custom property for an organization
tools.description: Deletes a custom property, specified by `custom_property_name`, from an existing organization (`org`) for which the property is currently defined, preventing its future assignment to repositories.

tools.name: Remove a label from an issue
tools.description: Removes a label currently applied to a specific issue in a repository.

tools.name: Remove all labels from an issue
tools.description: Removes all labels from a specified issue in a GitHub repository; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Remove all organization roles for a team
tools.description: Revokes all organization roles for a team in an organization; this is destructive and succeeds even if the team initially has no roles.

tools.name: Remove all organization roles for a user
tools.description: Revokes all assigned organization-level roles from a specified user (who must be a member of the organization) within a GitHub organization, without removing the user from the organization or affecting repository-specific roles.

tools.name: Remove an organization member
tools.description: Removes a member from a GitHub organization. This action permanently removes a user's membership from the specified organization, revoking their access to all organization resources, repositories, and teams. Requirements: - The authenticated user must be an organization owner - The target user must currently be a member of the organization Note: This action cannot be used to remove the last owner of an organization.

tools.name: Remove an organization role from a team
tools.description: Revokes an organization role that a team currently possesses within an organization.

tools.name: Remove an organization role from a user
tools.description: Removes a custom organization role from a user within a GitHub organization, provided the organization exists, the user is a member, and the role_id corresponds to a valid custom role in that organization.

tools.name: Remove app access restrictions
tools.description: Removes all GitHub App access restrictions from a protected branch in a repository; the branch must have protection rules configured, and this action does not alter user or team restrictions.

tools.name: Remove a project from a team
tools.description: Removes a project from a team within an organization; this action requires the project to be currently associated with the team.

tools.name: Remove a repository collaborator
tools.description: Removes a collaborator from a specified GitHub repository, provided the repository exists and the user is an existing collaborator.

tools.name: Remove a repository from an app installation
tools.description: Removes a repository from a GitHub App installation for the authenticated user, given a valid `installation_id` and the `repository_id` of a repository currently linked to that installation; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Remove a repository from a team
tools.description: Disassociates a repository from a team; team members may lose access permissions, but the repository and team are not deleted.

tools.name: Remove a selected repository from a user secret
tools.description: Removes a selected repository's access to a user's Codespaces secret; the secret must exist and the repository must have previously been granted access.

tools.name: Remove assignees from an issue
tools.description: Removes specified assignees from a GitHub issue; requires push access, and invalid removal attempts are silently ignored.

tools.name: Remove custom label from repo runner
tools.description: Removes a custom label from a repository's self-hosted runner; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Remove custom label from self hosted runner
tools.description: Removes a currently assigned custom label (`name`) from a self-hosted runner (`runner_id`) in an organization (`org`). This action allows the organization to manage the labels associated with their runners effectively.

tools.name: Remove custom labels from self hosted repo runner
tools.description: Removes all custom labels from a self-hosted runner registered at the repository level, leaving only its default labels and any labels inherited from its runner group or organization.

tools.name: Remove interaction restrictions for an organization
tools.description: Removes all interaction restrictions from public repositories in the specified GitHub organization, allowing all users to resume interactions.

tools.name: Remove interaction restrictions for a repository
tools.description: Removes all interaction restrictions for a repository, enabling all users to comment, open issues, and create pull requests by lifting any existing temporary interaction limits.

tools.name: Remove org dev env secret by name
tools.description: Deletes a GitHub Codespaces secret from an organization by its name; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Remove org secret by name
tools.description: Permanently removes a specific Dependabot secret, by its `secret_name`, from the GitHub `org`, making it unavailable to Dependabot for that organization.

tools.name: Remove outside collaborator from an organization
tools.description: Removes a user, who must be an outside collaborator, from the specified GitHub organization, revoking their access to all its repositories.

tools.name: Remove public org membership
tools.description: Removes the authenticated user's public organization membership, making it private. The user remains a member of the organization but their membership is no longer publicly visible. This operation is idempotent - calling it when the membership is already private will succeed.

tools.name: Remove user public repo interaction restrictions
tools.description: Removes all interaction restrictions (limitations on comments, issues, or pull requests) from all public repositories owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: Remove repository from organization dev environment secret
tools.description: Removes a repository's access to an organization-level Codespaces secret, if it was previously granted.

tools.name: Remove selected repo from org secret
tools.description: Revokes a specific repository's access to an organization-level Dependabot secret, applicable only when the secret has 'selected' visibility and the specified repository currently has access.

tools.name: Remove requested reviewers from a pull request
tools.description: Removes currently assigned user logins and/or team slugs from a GitHub pull request's list of requested reviewers.

tools.name: Remove selected repository from an organization secret
tools.description: Removes a specific repository's access to an organization-level secret; the repository must have been previously granted access to this secret.

tools.name: Remove selected repository from an organization variable
tools.description: Removes a repository's access to an organization variable that has 'selected' visibility. This endpoint removes a specific repository from an organization variable's access list. The variable must have its visibility set to 'selected' for this operation to work. Returns a 409 Conflict error if the variable visibility is not 'selected'.

tools.name: Remove status check contexts
tools.description: Removes specified status check contexts from a protected branch's required status checks. This action removes the specified status check contexts from the existing list of required status checks for a protected branch. The branch must already have branch protection enabled with status checks configured. Note: The 'contexts' parameter is deprecated by GitHub in favor of 'checks' array. For new implementations, consider using update_status_check_protection with the 'checks' parameter instead.

tools.name: Remove status check protection
tools.description: Removes status check protection from a branch, disabling required status checks for merging pull requests; will only have an effect if status check protection is currently configured on the branch.

tools.name: Remove team access restrictions
tools.description: Removes specified teams from push access to a protected branch. This action removes teams from the list of teams with push access to a protected branch. Removing a team will also remove push access for any child teams. Prerequisites: - The repository must be owned by an organization (not a personal account) - The branch must have protection rules enabled - The branch protection must have restrictions configured - The teams must currently have push access to the branch

tools.name: Remove team membership for a user
tools.description: Removes a user from a specific team within an organization. This action requires admin:org scope permissions. It will fail if: - Team synchronization with an Identity Provider (IdP) is enabled (403 Forbidden) - The organization, team, or user membership doesn't exist (404 Not Found) - You don't have sufficient permissions to manage team memberships (403 Forbidden) Note: If the removed user was the last member and the team is not nested, the team may be deleted automatically.

tools.name: Remove user access restrictions
tools.description: Removes specified users from the list of people allowed to push to a protected branch. Important notes: - This action only works on organization-owned repositories (not personal repos) - The branch must have protection rules with push restrictions enabled - Users being removed must currently have push access to the branch - The combined total of users, apps, and teams is limited to 100 items

tools.name: Remove user as a collaborator (classic project)
tools.description: Removes a user as a collaborator from an organization project (classic). IMPORTANT: This action uses the Projects (classic) REST API which is being deprecated. The Projects (classic) feature was sunset on GitHub.com. This API may still work on GitHub Enterprise Server versions before 3.17. Requirements: - You must be an organization owner or a project admin to remove a collaborator - The user must already be a collaborator on the specified project - The project must be an organization project (classic), not a Projects V2 project For GitHub.com users: Consider using GitHub Projects V2 instead, which can be managed through the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Remove users from codespaces access for an organization
tools.description: Removes selected users from GitHub Codespaces billing access for an existing organization.

tools.name: Rename a branch
tools.description: Renames an existing branch in a GitHub repository; the new name must be unique and adhere to GitHub's naming conventions, and the current branch name cannot contain wildcard characters.

tools.name: Render a markdown document
tools.description: Renders Markdown to HTML; for 'gfm' mode, provide 'context' (owner/repo) to correctly link issues, pull requests, and user mentions.

tools.name: Render Markdown (Raw Mode)
tools.description: Tool to render raw Markdown text to HTML using GitHub's markdown API. Use when you need to convert plain Markdown content to HTML without GitHub-specific features like issue references or @mentions.

tools.name: Replace all repository topics
tools.description: Replaces all topics of a repository.

tools.name: Replace org secret visibility to selected
tools.description: Replaces the list of repositories that can access a Dependabot organization secret when the secret's visibility is already set to 'selected'.

tools.name: Replace repository access for an org Codespaces secret
tools.description: Replaces the list of repositories that can access an organization-level Codespaces secret. This operation completely replaces the existing list of repositories with the provided list. The secret must already have its visibility set to 'selected' for this operation to succeed. Use this when you want to set an exact list of repositories that should have access. Prerequisites: - The organization must exist and you must have admin:org scope - The Codespaces secret must already exist in the organization - The secret's visibility must be set to 'selected' (not 'all' or 'private') Returns HTTP 204 No Content on success, 404 if secret/org not found, 409 if visibility is not 'selected'.

tools.name: Request a github pages build
tools.description: Manually triggers a GitHub Pages build for a repository if GitHub Pages is enabled, useful for deployments not automatically built or for retrying failed builds.

tools.name: Add reviewers to a specific pull request
tools.description: Adds reviewers to a specific pull request identified by owner, repo, and pull_number. This is NOT a search action - it operates on an already-known PR number. Requires `owner`, `repo`, `pull_number`, and at least one of `reviewers` or `team_reviewers`.

tools.name: Rerequest a check run
tools.description: Triggers a re-run of a specific check run in a GitHub repository, resetting its status to 'queued', clearing its conclusion, and triggering the `check_run` webhook with `rerequested` action. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires GitHub App authentication with 'checks:write' permission. The check run can ONLY be re-requested by the same GitHub App that originally created it. OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (PAT) cannot use this endpoint.

tools.name: Rerequest a check suite
tools.description: Triggers a new run of an existing check suite within a repository, resetting its status to 'queued', clearing its conclusion, and triggering the `check_suite` webhook with `rerequested` action. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires GitHub App authentication with 'checks:write' permission. OAuth tokens and classic personal access tokens (PAT) cannot use this endpoint. Only GitHub App user access tokens, GitHub App installation access tokens, or fine-grained personal access tokens with checks:write permission are supported.

tools.name: Re-run a job from a workflow run
tools.description: Re-runs a specific job and any dependent jobs from a GitHub Actions workflow run in the specified repository, optionally enabling debug logging.

tools.name: Rerun a workflow
tools.description: Re-runs a specific GitHub Actions workflow run identified by its owner, repository, and run ID, optionally enabling debug logging.

tools.name: Rerun failed jobs from a workflow run
tools.description: Re-runs all failed jobs and their dependent jobs from a specified workflow run if the run contains previously failed jobs.

tools.name: Reset a token
tools.description: Invalidates the provided OAuth `access_token` and generates a new one for the GitHub OAuth App identified by `client_id`. Used for token rotation when a token may be compromised or for regular security maintenance. Note: This endpoint requires the OAuth App owner's credentials (client_id/client_secret for Basic Auth).

tools.name: Restore a package for an organization
tools.description: Restores a package in an organization, provided it was deleted within the last 30 days.

tools.name: Restore a package for a user
tools.description: Restores a user-owned package previously deleted from GitHub Packages, if restorable under GitHub's data retention policy (typically within 30 days of deletion).

tools.name: Restore a package for the authenticated user
tools.description: Restores a package deleted by the authenticated user within the last 30 days, if its namespace and version are still available.

tools.name: Restore a package version for the authenticated user
tools.description: Restores a package version that was deleted by the authenticated user within the last 30 days.

tools.name: Restore package version for an organization
tools.description: Restores a package version for an organization, provided it was deleted within the last 30 days.

tools.name: Restore package version for a user
tools.description: Restores a specific, user-owned package version if it was deleted within the last 30 days and its original namespace and version name are still available.

tools.name: Retire Sponsors Tier
tools.description: Tool to retire a published payment tier from your GitHub Sponsors profile using GraphQL. Use when you need to prevent a tier from being used for new sponsorships. Existing sponsors at this tier remain unaffected.

tools.name: Review access with personal token
tools.description: Approves or denies a pending fine-grained personal access token request for organization resources; must be performed by a GitHub App.

tools.name: Review Custom Deployment Rules For Workflow Run
tools.description: Approves or rejects pending custom deployment protection rules for a workflow run. This endpoint allows GitHub Apps to review their own pending custom deployment protection rules for a specific workflow run. The review can either approve (allowing the deployment to proceed) or reject (blocking the deployment). **Important notes:** - GitHub Apps can only review their own custom deployment protection rules - This endpoint requires GitHub App installation access tokens with Deployments permission (write) - Custom deployment protection rules are available in public repos for all plans; for private/internal repos, GitHub Enterprise is required - Returns 204 No Content on success

tools.name: Review pending deployments for a workflow run
tools.description: Approves or rejects pending deployments for a specific workflow run that are in a 'waiting' state within specified, configured environments.

tools.name: Review PAT Requests in Bulk
tools.description: Approves or denies multiple fine-grained personal access token requests for an organization in bulk. This endpoint processes multiple PAT request approvals or denials in a single API call. All specified pat_request_ids must refer to currently pending requests. Important: This endpoint can ONLY be called by GitHub Apps with the 'organization_personal_access_token_requests:write' permission. It cannot be called with personal access tokens or OAuth apps. On success, returns HTTP 202 Accepted with an empty body.

tools.name: Revoke an installation access token
tools.description: Revokes the GitHub App's current installation access token, immediately invalidating it for API authentication. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires a GitHub App installation access token (ghs_* prefix) for authentication. OAuth tokens (gho_*) or personal access tokens are not supported and will result in a 403 Forbidden error. After successful revocation, the token becomes permanently invalid and cannot be used for any subsequent API calls. To continue API operations, a new installation access token must be generated.

tools.name: Run GraphQL Query
tools.description: Tool to run an arbitrary GitHub GraphQL v4 query or mutation. Use when fetching multiple datasets in one batch. Cost-based rate limit: ~5,000 points/hour; keep field selections narrow, avoid deep nesting, and include rateLimit in responses to monitor quota. Responses are nested under data.data (e.g., data.data.repository.vulnerabilityAlerts); always inspect the errors array even on HTTP 200, as partial failures embed there. Paginate by looping on pageInfo.hasNextPage and advancing with pageInfo.endCursor. Search results cap at ~1,000 items per query; split by label, date range, or repository for full coverage. Use ProjectV2 nodes, not Classic Projects (deprecated). Parallel mutations (e.g., addProjectV2ItemById) can trigger transient conflicts; use sequential execution.

tools.name: Run GraphQL Relay Query
tools.description: Tool to run a GitHub GraphQL relay query. The relay field is a workaround for re-exposing the root query object. Use when you need to access root query fields through the relay context.

tools.name: Search code
tools.description: Searches code file contents and paths on the default branch of GitHub repositories using a query string; searches only files under 384KB, returns max 1000 results by best match, and is optimized for precision.

tools.name: Search code (all pages)
tools.description: Tool to search code across multiple pages using GitHub's code search API. Use when single-page searches may miss matches and you need a full or capped result set. GitHub caps results at ~1,000 total items regardless of pagination; results for broad queries may be silently truncated. Only the default branch is indexed, and very large files may be excluded — treat results as potentially partial. Rate limit: ~30 requests/minute; honor `Retry-After` on 403/429 responses.

tools.name: Search commits
tools.description: Finds commits on GitHub using a query string (q) supporting keywords and qualifiers, with options for sorting and pagination.

tools.name: Search commits by author across repos
tools.description: Searches commits across GitHub using the Search API (e.g., by author/email/org/date range) without per-repo scanning. Use when you need to find commits by author, committer email, organization, or date ranges across multiple repositories. This avoids the need to list commits per repository and prevents 409 errors on empty repos.

tools.name: GitHub GraphQL Search
tools.description: Tool to perform GitHub GraphQL searches across issues, pull requests, repositories, users, and discussions. Returns up to 1,000 results with cursor-based pagination. Use when you need structured search results with specific fields.

tools.name: Search issues and pull requests
tools.description: Searches GitHub for issues and pull requests. Supports keywords, qualifiers (repo:, org:, user:, state:, label:, author:, assignee:, mentions:, etc.), and type filters (is:issue, is:pr). Type filters cannot be used alone - they must be combined with at least one keyword or other qualifier. All other qualifiers work independently. The @me shorthand (e.g., assignee:@me, mentions:@me) is automatically resolved to your username. Logical operators (AND, OR, NOT) are supported but limited to a maximum of 5 operators total per query.

tools.name: Search labels
tools.description: Searches for labels within a GitHub repository by keywords in their names or descriptions.

tools.name: Search repositories
tools.description: Searches GitHub repositories using a flexible query (keywords, qualifiers) with sorting, ordering, and pagination. IMPORTANT: The 'q' parameter (search query) is REQUIRED and must always be provided.

tools.name: Search topics
tools.description: Finds topics on GitHub using keywords and qualifiers with GitHub's search syntax, supporting pagination.

tools.name: Search users
tools.description: Searches for users on GitHub by criteria like username, email, location, followers, or repository associations, using a flexible query string `q`.

tools.name: Set admin branch protection
tools.description: Enables administrator enforcement on a branch, making existing protection rules also apply to administrators; branch protection rules must already be configured.

tools.name: Set app access restrictions
tools.description: Replaces the list of GitHub Apps permitted to push to a protected branch. This action completely replaces the existing list of apps with push access - it does not add to or merge with the current list. Requirements: - The branch must already have protection rules enabled with push restrictions configured - Apps must be installed on the repository and have 'contents' write permission - Push restrictions are only available for organization-owned repositories with GitHub Team or Enterprise Cloud plans

tools.name: Set a repository subscription
tools.description: Sets the authenticated user's notification subscription for a repository.

tools.name: Set a thread subscription
tools.description: Sets whether a GitHub notification thread is ignored (muted) or unignored (unmuted), for a `thread_id` that must identify an existing notification thread.

tools.name: Set default workflow permissions for an organization
tools.description: Updates an organization's default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions for workflows and whether GitHub Actions can approve pull requests; note that allowing Actions to approve pull requests (`can_approve_pull_request_reviews: true`) is a security risk.

tools.name: Set default workflow permissions for a repository
tools.description: Sets the default permissions for the GITHUB_TOKEN within a repository and configures whether GitHub Actions can approve pull requests.

tools.name: Set primary email visibility
tools.description: Sets the visibility ('public' or 'private') of the authenticated user's primary email address on GitHub, if one is configured.

tools.name: Set GitHub Actions permissions for an organization
tools.description: Sets the GitHub Actions permissions policy for an organization, specifying which repositories can run Actions and which actions/workflows are allowed; if 'selected' is chosen for either, manage the specific lists via other endpoints.

tools.name: Set github actions permissions for a repository
tools.description: Sets GitHub Actions permissions for a repository, enabling/disabling Actions and defining the policy for allowed actions and reusable workflows.

tools.name: Set interaction restrictions for an organization
tools.description: Limits interactions (comments, new issues, PRs) in an organization's public repositories by user type and duration, typically to mitigate high traffic or unwanted activity.

tools.name: Set interaction restrictions for a repository
tools.description: Temporarily limits which GitHub users (e.g., existing_users, contributors_only) can interact (comment, open issues, create pull requests) in a repository for a specified duration.

tools.name: Set interaction restrictions for your public repositories
tools.description: Sets or updates temporary interaction restrictions for all public repositories owned by the authenticated user, overriding any repository-specific limits.

tools.name: Set labels for an issue
tools.description: Replaces all existing labels on a GitHub issue with a new set of labels.

tools.name: Set custom OIDC subject claim template
tools.description: Sets the OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim template for a GitHub repository, allowing use of the default template or a custom one defined by `include_claim_keys` if `use_default` is `false`.

tools.name: Set allowed actions and workflows for an organization
tools.description: Sets the GitHub Actions permissions for an existing organization, specifying allowed GitHub-owned actions, verified creator actions, and action/workflow patterns from public repositories.

tools.name: Set custom labels for a self-hosted runner for an organization
tools.description: Sets the custom labels for a self-hosted runner in an organization; this operation does not affect default system-assigned labels (e.g., 'self-hosted', 'linux', 'x64').

tools.name: Set repo allowed actions
tools.description: Sets allowed GitHub Actions and reusable workflows for a repository, managing permissions for GitHub-owned, verified creator, or specific pattern-matched actions/workflows (note: `patterns_allowed` applies only to public repositories).

tools.name: Set custom labels for repo runner
tools.description: Replaces all custom labels for a specific self-hosted runner in a repository; an empty list for `labels` removes all existing custom labels.

tools.name: Set selected repositories for an organization variable
tools.description: Replaces the list of repositories that can access an organization-level variable; the variable's visibility must be 'selected'.

tools.name: Set selected repositories for an organization secret
tools.description: Replaces the list of repositories that can access an organization secret; only effective if the secret's visibility is 'selected'. Prerequisites: - The organization secret must already exist - The secret's visibility must be set to 'selected' (not 'all' or 'private') - Requires admin:org scope or actions secrets fine-grained permission This action completely replaces the repository access list. To add or remove individual repositories without affecting others, use the dedicated add/remove repository actions instead.

tools.name: Set selected repositories for a user secret
tools.description: Defines the list of repositories permitted to access a specific Codespaces secret for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Set status check contexts
tools.description: Replaces required status check contexts for a protected branch, requiring admin permissions; an empty `contexts` array removes all checks.

tools.name: Set team access restrictions
tools.description: Replaces the list of teams with push access to a protected branch. This action sets (replaces) the teams that have push access to a protected branch. Unlike 'Add team access restrictions' (POST), this action replaces the entire list rather than adding to it. Use an empty list to remove all team restrictions. Prerequisites: - The repository must be owned by an organization (not a personal account) - The branch must have protection rules enabled - The branch protection must have restrictions configured - The teams must exist in the organization and have repository access

tools.name: Set user access restrictions
tools.description: Replaces the list of users with push access to a protected branch in an organization repository. Important notes: - This action only works on organization-owned repositories (not personal repos) - The branch must already have protection rules with restrictions enabled - This REPLACES (not adds to) the existing list of users with push access - Users must have write access to the repository to be added - The combined total of users, apps, and teams is limited to 100 items - To add users without replacing, use the 'add_user_access_restrictions' action instead

tools.name: Set User Interaction Limit (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to set interaction limits on a user's public repositories using GraphQL. Use when you need to temporarily restrict who can comment, open issues, or create pull requests. Limits apply to the authenticated user or a specified user.

tools.name: Set workflow access level outside repository
tools.description: Sets the access level for workflows outside a repository to use actions and reusable workflows within that repository.

tools.name: Star a gist
tools.description: Stars a GitHub gist identified by `gist_id`; this action is idempotent and returns a 204 No Content status upon success, even if the gist is already starred.

tools.name: Star a specified repository (requires owner and repo)
tools.description: Stars a specified repository (identified by owner and repo name) for the authenticated user; this action is idempotent and succeeds even if the repository is already starred. Requires explicit repository identification via owner and repo parameters.

tools.name: Start a codespace for the authenticated user
tools.description: Initiates the startup process for an existing GitHub Codespace (identified by `codespace_name`) if it's in a startable state like 'Available' or 'Stopped'.

tools.name: Stop a codespace for an organization user
tools.description: Stops a running codespace for an organization member. This action allows organization administrators to stop a codespace that belongs to a member of their organization. The codespace must be in a running state (e.g., 'Available') to be stopped. Required permissions: - OAuth/PAT: admin:org scope - Fine-grained tokens: 'Organization codespaces' (write) or 'Codespaces lifecycle admin' (write) Common HTTP responses: - 200: Codespace successfully stopped, returns codespace object - 304: Not modified (codespace already stopped) - 401: Authentication required - 403: Insufficient permissions (need admin:org) - 404: Organization, user, or codespace not found

tools.name: Stop a codespace for the authenticated user
tools.description: Stops a running or available Codespace for the authenticated user, pausing its execution and billing.

tools.name: Submit a review for a pull request
tools.description: Finalizes a pending pull request review (identified by `review_id`) with a required `event` (APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, COMMENT) and an optional `body`.

tools.name: Sync a fork branch with the upstream repository
tools.description: Synchronizes a branch in a forked GitHub repository with its upstream counterpart, assuming the repository is a fork, the branch exists, an upstream is configured, and the merge is conflict-free.

tools.name: Test the push repository webhook
tools.description: Triggers a simulated push event to test a repository's push webhook; a test event is only delivered if the webhook is subscribed to 'push' events, otherwise, it returns 204 No Content without sending a POST.

tools.name: Transfer a repository
