name: Hacker News
description: Hacker News is a tech-focused news aggregator by Y Combinator, featuring user-submitted stories and discussions on startups, programming, and emerging trends

tools.name: Get Ask HN Story IDs
tools.description: Get up to 200 latest Ask HN story IDs from Hacker News. Returns an array of item IDs for Ask HN posts in ranked order.

tools.name: Get Best HackerNews Stories
tools.description: Get up to 500 best story IDs from HackerNews ranked by score. Returns story IDs only. Use the returned IDs with get_item_with_id action to fetch full story details.

tools.name: Get Hacker News Item
tools.description: Tool to get a Hacker News item by its unique ID from the Firebase API. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific story, comment, job, poll, or pollopt.

tools.name: Get Hackernews Item
tools.description: Get a specific item from Hacker News using its ID. Limits response size to prevent context overflow.

tools.name: Get Job Story IDs
tools.description: Get up to 200 latest job story IDs from Hacker News. Returns an array of item IDs for job postings that can be used to fetch full job details.

tools.name: Get Latest Hackernews Posts
tools.description: Get the latest posts from Hacker News based on optional filters. Results can be limited using the size parameter.

tools.name: Get Max Item ID
tools.description: Tool to get the current largest item ID from Hacker News. Use when you need to discover the most recent items or iterate through all items in the system by walking backward from this ID.

tools.name: Get New Hacker News Stories
tools.description: Get up to 500 newest story IDs from Hacker News. Returns an array of item IDs sorted by recency (most recent first). Use these IDs with the Get Item action to retrieve full story details.

tools.name: Get Show HN Stories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve up to 200 latest Show HN story IDs from Hacker News. Use when you need to find recent Show HN posts where people share their projects, products, or creations.

tools.name: Get Top HackerNews Stories
tools.description: Get up to 500 top story IDs from HackerNews including jobs. Returns story IDs sorted by front page position. Use the returned IDs with get_item_with_id action to fetch full story details.

tools.name: Get Hacker News Updates
tools.description: Get recently changed items and user profiles from Hacker News. Use this to monitor recent activity or updates on the platform.

tools.name: Get Hacker News User
tools.description: Retrieve a Hacker News user's public profile by their username. Returns the user's username, karma score, and optional bio/about text. Use this to look up information about HN community members.

tools.name: Get HackerNews User by Username
tools.description: Tool to get a user profile by their case-sensitive username from the HackerNews Firebase API. Use when you need detailed user information including creation date, karma, bio, and submission history. Only users with public activity are available.

tools.name: Search Hackernews Posts
tools.description: Search Hacker News posts using full-text search powered by Algolia. Use this action to find stories, comments, and discussions on Hacker News matching specific keywords. Supports filtering by post type (story, comment, show_hn, ask_hn) and by author.

name: ElevenLabs
description: Create natural AI voices instantly in any language - perfect for video creators, developers, and businesses.

tools.name: Add a pronunciation dictionary from file
tools.description: Adds a new pronunciation dictionary from a lexicon file to improve speech synthesis accuracy.

tools.name: Add outbound phone number
tools.description: Tool to import/register a Twilio phone number or SIP trunk into ElevenLabs Agents Platform. Use when you need to provision a phone number for outbound calls and ELEVENLABS_GET_AGENT_DETAILS returns empty phone_numbers. This does NOT purchase a new number; it imports an existing provider configuration into your ElevenLabs workspace.

tools.name: Add new project with attributes
tools.description: Use to create a new ElevenLabs project for text-to-speech synthesis (e.g., audiobooks); a project `name` is required by the API for creation, and content can be initialized using `from_url` or `from_document`.

tools.name: Add pronunciation dictionary from rules
tools.description: Tool to create a new pronunciation dictionary from provided rules for ElevenLabs text-to-speech. Use when you need to define custom pronunciations for specific words or phrases to improve speech accuracy. Supports both alias rules (simple text replacements) and phoneme rules (IPA phonetic notation).

tools.name: Add rules to the pronunciation dictionary
tools.description: Adds one or more custom pronunciation rules (alias or phoneme) to an existing pronunciation dictionary.

tools.name: Add sharing voice
tools.description: Adds an existing, shareable voice to a specified user's ElevenLabs account library under a new custom name, requiring the user's public ID and the voice ID.

tools.name: Add a voice
tools.description: Adds a custom voice by uploading audio samples for voice cloning. Requires a name and at least one audio file. Recommended: 1-2 minutes of clear audio without background noise. Supported formats: mp3, wav, ogg. Returns a voice_id that can be used for text-to-speech after processing completes.

tools.name: Attach phone number to agent
tools.description: Tool to assign or unassign an existing imported phone number to an agent by updating the phone number's assigned agent. Use when you need to programmatically route inbound calls to a specific agent or change agent assignment for a phone number.

tools.name: Calculate ConvAI Agent LLM Usage
tools.description: Tool to calculate expected number of LLM tokens needed for a conversational AI agent. Use when estimating costs for an agent based on knowledge base size, prompt length, and RAG configuration.

tools.name: Calculate ConvAI LLM Usage
tools.description: Tool to calculate expected LLM usage costs for conversational AI agents. Use when you need to estimate pricing for different LLM models based on prompt length, knowledge base size, and RAG configuration.

tools.name: Cancel Batch Call
tools.description: Tool to cancel a running batch call and set all recipients to cancelled status. Use when you need to stop an ongoing batch calling campaign.

tools.name: Convert chapter to audio
tools.description: Converts the textual content of a chapter, identified by `chapter_id` within a `project_id`, into audio format.

tools.name: Convert a project
tools.description: Converts an existing ElevenLabs Studio project, including all its chapters and using its configured settings and voices, into speech.

tools.name: Create a previously generated voice
tools.description: Finalizes the creation of a voice using its `generated_voice_id` from a previous generation step by assigning a name, description, and optional labels.

tools.name: Create Conversational AI Agent Test
tools.description: Tool to create a new ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent response test. Use when you need to set up automated testing for agent responses, tool calls, or conversation simulations. Supports three test types: 'llm' for response validation, 'tool_call' for tool execution verification, and 'simulation' for full conversation testing.

tools.name: Add to ConvAI Knowledge Base
tools.description: Tool to add documentation to ElevenLabs Conversational AI knowledge base by uploading a file or referencing a webpage URL. Use when you need to provide reference materials or documentation that agents can access during conversations. Exactly one of 'file' or 'url' must be specified.

tools.name: Create ConvAI Knowledge Base File
tools.description: Tool to create a knowledge base document from an uploaded file for ElevenLabs Conversational AI agents. Use when you need to provide documentation or reference material that agents can access during conversations. The uploaded file content will be indexed and made available to agents for answering user queries.

tools.name: Create ConvAI Knowledge Base Folder
tools.description: Tool to create a folder in the ElevenLabs ConvAI knowledge base for organizing documents. Use when you need to group related documents together in a hierarchical structure.

tools.name: Create ConvAI Knowledge Base RAG Index
tools.description: Tool to compute or retrieve RAG indexes for multiple knowledge base documents in batch. Use when you need to enable semantic search on multiple knowledge base documents for conversational AI agents. This endpoint creates embeddings if missing or returns existing indexes, supporting up to 100 documents per request.

tools.name: Create Knowledge Base Text Document
tools.description: Tool to create a knowledge base document with text content in ElevenLabs Conversational AI. Use when you need to add text-based information to the knowledge base for agent reference.

tools.name: Create Knowledge Base URL Document
tools.description: Tool to create a knowledge base document by scraping the given webpage. Use when you need to add a web page as a knowledge source for a conversational AI agent.

tools.name: Create ConvAI Workspace Secret
tools.description: Tool to create a new secret for the ElevenLabs ConvAI workspace. Use when you need to securely store API keys, tokens, or other sensitive values that your conversational AI agents can reference.

tools.name: Create Conversational AI Tool
tools.description: Tool to create a new conversational AI tool in ElevenLabs workspace. Use when adding custom tools for agents to execute during conversations. Supports webhook (external HTTP APIs), client (client-side execution), system (built-in), and MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool types.

tools.name: Create Conversational AI Agent
tools.description: Tool to create a new ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent with specified configuration. Use when you need to programmatically set up an agent with custom prompts, voice settings, and behavior. After creating the agent, you can chain other tools to attach phone numbers or configure additional settings.

tools.name: Generate Music Composition Plan
tools.description: Tool to generate a music composition plan from a text prompt using ElevenLabs Music API. Use when you need to create a structured plan for music generation with defined styles, sections, and durations. The generated plan can be used as input for actual music generation or as a template for variations.

tools.name: Create an AudioNative enabled project
tools.description: Creates an ElevenLabs AudioNative project, generating an embeddable audio player from a provided content file using text-to-speech, allowing customization of player appearance, audio settings, and conversion options.

tools.name: Get similar library voices
tools.description: Returns a list of shared voices similar to the provided audio sample. Use when you need to find voice matches based on audio characteristics. If neither similarity_threshold nor top_k is provided, default values will be applied.

tools.name: Create Single Use Token
tools.description: Tool to generate a time-limited single-use token with embedded authentication for frontend clients. Use when you need secure, temporary access tokens for WebSocket connections or real-time services.

tools.name: Create Workspace Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook for the workspace with specified authentication type. Use when you need to configure a webhook endpoint to receive notifications from ElevenLabs. The webhook_secret returned should be stored securely for verifying webhook authenticity.

tools.name: Delete chapter from project
tools.description: Irreversibly deletes a specific, existing chapter from an existing project, typically to remove unwanted or obsolete content.

tools.name: Delete Conversational AI Agent
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Conversational AI agent by its unique identifier. Use when you need to remove an agent configuration from the ElevenLabs workspace.

tools.name: Delete agent response test
tools.description: Tool to delete an agent response test by ID. Use when you need to remove a test result or clean up test data.

tools.name: Delete batch call
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a batch call and all associated recipient records. Conversations remain in history. Use when cleaning up completed or cancelled batch calls.

tools.name: Delete conversation by ID
tools.description: Tool to delete a particular Conversational AI conversation by ID. Use when you need to remove a conversation from the system for cleanup, compliance, or data management purposes.

tools.name: Delete Knowledge Base Document or Folder
tools.description: Tool to delete a document or folder from the knowledge base. Use when you need to remove a knowledge base document or folder that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete ConvAI Knowledge Base RAG Index
tools.description: Tool to delete RAG index for a knowledge base document. Use when you need to remove semantic search indexing from a document to free up resources or when the document no longer needs to be indexed.

tools.name: Delete workspace secret
tools.description: Tool to delete a workspace secret if it's not in use. Use when you need to remove unused secrets from the conversational AI workspace for security or cleanup purposes.

tools.name: Delete conversational AI tool
tools.description: Tool to delete a conversational AI tool from the workspace by ID. Use when you need to remove a tool configuration that is no longer needed or to clean up outdated tool definitions.

tools.name: Delete a dubbing project
tools.description: Permanently deletes a dubbing project by its ID; this action is irreversible and the project cannot be recovered.

tools.name: Delete history item
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific history item (including its audio file and metadata) using its `history_item_id`; this operation is irreversible and should be used with caution.

tools.name: Delete MCP server
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific MCP server configuration from the workspace. Use when you need to remove an MCP server that is no longer needed or to clean up outdated configurations.

tools.name: Delete phone number by id
tools.description: Tool to delete an imported phone number from the ElevenLabs workspace by ID. Use when you need to remove a phone number configuration for cleanup or to avoid stale configurations in automated environments.

tools.name: Delete project by id
tools.description: Use to irreversibly delete a specific project by its `project_id`; the project must exist and be accessible, and this action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete voice sample
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific voice sample for a given voice ID; this action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete voice by id
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specific custom voice using its `voice_id`; the voice must exist and the authenticated user must have permission to delete it.

tools.name: Delete workspace webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a specified workspace webhook by its ID. Use when you need to remove a webhook configuration that is no longer needed or to clean up webhook integrations.

tools.name: Download history items
tools.description: Downloads audio clips from history by ID(s), returning a single file or a ZIP archive, with an optional output format (e.g., 'wav'); provides only audio content, no metadata.

tools.name: Dub a video or an audio file
tools.description: Dub a video or audio file into a specified target language, requiring 'file' or 'source_url', 'target_lang', and 'csv_file' if 'mode' is 'manual'.

tools.name: Duplicate Conversational AI Agent
tools.description: Tool to create a new agent by duplicating an existing one. Use when you need to clone an agent's configuration. The new agent will inherit all settings from the original agent but can be given a new name.

tools.name: Edit voice
tools.description: Updates the name, audio files, description, or labels for an existing voice model. The voice_id must be for a voice owned by you (cloned voices). Premade/default voices cannot be edited. The 'name' field is required for all edit operations. This endpoint uses multipart/form-data format for the request body.

tools.name: Edit voice settings
tools.description: Edits key voice settings (e.g., stability, similarity enhancement, style exaggeration, speaker boost) for an existing voice, affecting all future audio generated with that voice ID.

tools.name: Generate a random voice
tools.description: Generates a unique, random ElevenLabs text-to-speech voice based on input text and specified voice characteristics.

tools.name: Get agent details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available Conversational AI agents and outbound-capable Twilio phone numbers. Use when selecting an agent and phone number for outbound calls. Always reference agents by agent_id (stable identifier), not agent_name (mutable). Returns basic metadata only — conversation_config and webhook settings require a separate ConvAI agent API call. Pass agent_id and agent_phone_number_id directly to ELEVENLABS_OUTBOUND_CALL; IDs must be current and owned by the authenticated account.

tools.name: Get Agent Link
tools.description: Tool to get the current shareable link for a Conversational AI agent. Use when you need to retrieve the link URL for sharing the agent with others.

tools.name: Get user profile
tools.description: Retrieves the profile information for the authenticated ElevenLabs user (identified by API key).

tools.name: Get audio from history item
tools.description: Retrieves the audio content for a specific history item from ElevenLabs, using a `history_item_id` that must correspond to a previously generated audio.

tools.name: Get sample audio
tools.description: Retrieves the audio for a given `sample_id` that must belong to the specified `voice_id`.

tools.name: Get audio native settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve player settings for a specific Audio Native project. Use when you need to check the current configuration of an audio-native project, including display settings, colors, and status.

tools.name: Get chapter by ID
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specific chapter within a given project, including its metadata (name, ID), conversion status, progress, download availability, and content statistics.

tools.name: Get chapters by project id
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all chapters, their details, and conversion status for a project, useful for managing content or tracking progress.

tools.name: Get chapter snapshots
tools.description: Retrieves all saved version snapshots for a specific chapter within a given project, enabling review of its history or reversion to prior states.

tools.name: Get Conversational AI Agent
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the complete configuration for a specific Conversational AI agent by ID. Use when you need to inspect or audit an agent's settings, workflow, conversation config, or assigned channels.

tools.name: Get Agent Knowledge Base Size
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the number of pages in a conversational AI agent's knowledge base. Use when you need to check the size of an agent's knowledge base content.

tools.name: Get ConvAI Agents Summaries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve summaries for specified Conversational AI agents. Use when you need to fetch metadata such as name, tags, creation time, access level, and archival status for one or more agents.

tools.name: Get Agent Widget Config
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the widget configuration for a Conversational AI agent. Use when you need to fetch display settings, colors, text content, and behavior options for an agent's embedded widget.

tools.name: Get Agent Response Test By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent response test by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details of a specific test including its configuration, type, and test parameters.

tools.name: Get conversational AI analytics live count
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the live count of active ongoing Conversational AI conversations. Use when monitoring real-time conversation activity or checking current load.

tools.name: Get batch call details
tools.description: Tool to get detailed information about a batch call including all recipients. Use when you need to check the status, progress, or results of a previously submitted batch calling job.

tools.name: Get Batch Calls for Workspace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all batch calls for the current workspace. Use when you need to list all batch calling campaigns, check their status, or find specific batch calls by name or agent.

tools.name: Get Conversational AI Conversations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all conversations of agents that user owns. Use when you need to list conversations, optionally filtered by agent, time range, duration, rating, or other criteria. Supports pagination via cursor.

tools.name: Get ConvAI Knowledge Base
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of available knowledge base documents. Use when you need to browse, search, or filter knowledge base documents by name, type, folder, or ownership. Supports pagination via cursor for large result sets.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base Document Content
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the entire content of a document from the knowledge base. Use when you need to access or read the full text content of a knowledge base document.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base Dependent Agents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of agents depending on a specific knowledge base document. Use when you need to identify which agents are using a particular document, either directly or transitively.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base Documentation
tools.description: Tool to get details about a specific documentation making up the agent's knowledge base. Use when you need to retrieve information about a knowledge base document, including its content, type, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base RAG Index Overview
tools.description: Tool to retrieve RAG index overview including total size and usage information. Use when you need to check storage limits, monitor usage, or understand which embedding models are consuming space in knowledge base documents.

tools.name: Get ConvAI Knowledge Base RAG Indexes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all RAG indexes for a specified knowledge base document. Use when you need to view the indexing status, models used, and usage statistics for a document's semantic search capabilities.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base Source File URL
tools.description: Tool to get a signed URL to download the original source file of a file-type document from the knowledge base. Use when you need to download the original file that was uploaded to create a knowledge base document.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base Summaries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve knowledge base document summaries by their IDs. Use when you need to get summaries for multiple knowledge base documents in a single request.

tools.name: Get ConvAI MCP Server
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific MCP server configuration from the workspace. Use when you need to inspect details of an existing MCP server including its URL, transport type, approval policies, and dependent agents.

tools.name: Get ConvAI MCP Servers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configurations available in the workspace. Use when you need to list all registered MCP servers or check which servers are available for conversational AI agents.

tools.name: Get ConvAI MCP Server Tools
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all tools available for a specific MCP server configuration. Use when you need to inspect what tools an MCP server provides or verify tool availability before using them.

tools.name: Get Phone Number by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed configuration for a specific phone number by ID. Use when you need to inspect a phone number's provider details, capabilities, agent assignments, or SIP trunk configuration.

tools.name: Get ConvAI Workspace Secrets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all workspace secrets for the user. Use when you need to list stored secrets that can be used for authentication and integration with conversational AI agents. Supports pagination.

tools.name: Get Convai Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Convai settings for the workspace. Use when you need to inspect webhook configurations, RAG retention settings, or MCP server capabilities.

tools.name: Get Convai Dashboard Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Convai dashboard settings for the workspace. Use when you need to inspect configured dashboard charts for monitoring conversational AI performance.

tools.name: List Test Invocations
tools.description: Tool to list all test invocations for a specific conversational AI agent with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve test invocation history, check test results, or paginate through large sets of test runs.

tools.name: Get Conversational AI Tool
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the complete configuration for a specific conversational AI tool by ID. Use when you need to inspect a tool's settings, type, or usage statistics from the workspace.

tools.name: Get ConvAI tools
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available tools in the workspace. Use when you need to list, search, or discover tools that can be used with Conversational AI agents.

tools.name: Get Tool Dependent Agents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of agents depending on a specific tool. Use when you need to identify which agents are using a particular tool in their configuration.

tools.name: Get conversation by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch full details for a single Conversational AI conversation by ID. Use when you need transcript-level analysis, metadata, or audio status flags for a specific conversation.

tools.name: Get Conversation Signed URL
tools.description: Tool to get a signed URL to start a conversation with an agent that requires authorization. Use when you need to obtain a secure WebSocket URL for initiating a conversation session.

tools.name: Get default voice settings
tools.description: Retrieves the ElevenLabs text-to-speech service's default voice settings (stability, similarity boost, style, speaker boost) that are applied when no voice-specific or request-specific settings are provided.

tools.name: Get dubbed audio for a language
tools.description: Retrieves an existing dubbed audio file for a specific `dubbing_id` and `language_code`.

tools.name: Get dubbing project metadata
tools.description: Retrieves metadata and status for a specific dubbing project by its ID.

tools.name: Get dubbing transcript in specific format
tools.description: Retrieves the transcript for a specific dubbing project and language in the requested format (SRT, WebVTT, or JSON). Use this when you need subtitles or detailed transcript data with timing information for a dubbed video or audio.

tools.name: Get generated items
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a list of generated audio items from history, supporting pagination and optional filtering by voice ID.

tools.name: Get history item by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information (excluding the audio file) for a specific audio generation history item from ElevenLabs, using its unique ID.

tools.name: Get MCP Tool Configuration
tools.description: Tool to retrieve configuration overrides for a specific MCP tool within an MCP server. Use when you need to inspect the custom execution settings for individual tools.

tools.name: Get pronunciation dictionary metadata
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific, existing pronunciation dictionary from ElevenLabs using its ID.

tools.name: Get models
tools.description: Retrieves a detailed list of all available ElevenLabs text-to-speech (TTS) models and their capabilities.

tools.name: Get project by ID
tools.description: Use to retrieve all details for a specific project, including its chapters and their conversion statuses, by providing the project's unique ID.

tools.name: Get projects
tools.description: Fetches a list of all projects and their details associated with the user's ElevenLabs account; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Get project snapshots
tools.description: Retrieves all available snapshots (saved states or versions) for an existing project, enabling history tracking, version comparison, or accessing specific states for playback/processing, particularly in text-to-speech workflows.

tools.name: Get pronunciation dictionaries
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of pronunciation dictionaries, used to customize how specific words or phrases are pronounced by the text-to-speech (TTS) engine.

tools.name: Get pronunciation dictionary version
tools.description: Downloads the Pronunciation Lexicon Specification (PLS) file for an existing version of a pronunciation dictionary from ElevenLabs, used to customize TTS pronunciation.

tools.name: Get Service Accounts
tools.description: Tool to list all service accounts in the workspace. Use when you need to view service accounts, their associated API keys, or manage workspace access.

tools.name: Get shared voices
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated and filterable list of shared voices from the ElevenLabs Voice Library.

tools.name: Get sso provider admin
tools.description: Retrieves the SSO provider configuration for a specified workspace, typically for review purposes, and will indicate if no configuration exists.

tools.name: Get Agent Response Test Summaries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple agent response test summaries by their IDs. Use when you need to fetch summary information for multiple tests in a single request. Returns a dictionary mapping test IDs to their summary details including name, type, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get dubbing transcript by language
tools.description: Retrieves the textual transcript for a specified dubbing project and language, if one exists for that language in the project.

tools.name: Get Usage Character Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve usage metrics for the current user or entire workspace. Returns time-series data with configurable aggregation intervals and breakdown types. Use when analyzing character usage patterns, tracking consumption by voice, user, or other dimensions over time.

tools.name: Get user info
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about the authenticated ElevenLabs user's account, including subscription, usage, API key, and status.

tools.name: Get user subscription info
tools.description: Retrieves detailed subscription information for the currently authenticated ElevenLabs user.

tools.name: Get voice
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific, existing voice by its `voice_id`, optionally including its settings.

tools.name: Get voices list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all available voices along with their detailed attributes and settings.

tools.name: Get voice settings
tools.description: Retrieves the stability, similarity, style, and speaker boost settings for a specific, existing ElevenLabs voice using its `voice_id`.

tools.name: Get workspace resource metadata
tools.description: Tool to get metadata of a workspace resource by ID and type. Use when you need access control information, creator details, or sharing options for a specific resource.

tools.name: Get Workspace Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all webhooks configured for the workspace. Use when you need to view existing webhook configurations or verify webhook settings.

tools.name: List Conversational AI Agent Tests
tools.description: Tool to list all agent response tests with pagination support and optional search filtering. Use when you need to retrieve available tests, search tests by name, or paginate through large test collections.

tools.name: List Dubs
tools.description: Tool to list dubbing projects you have access to. Use when you need to retrieve dubs, check their status, or paginate through available dubbing projects.

tools.name: List Phone Numbers
tools.description: Tool to list all imported phone numbers in the workspace. Use when you need to find available phone numbers, check their capabilities (inbound/outbound), or verify which agent is assigned to a number.

tools.name: List WhatsApp Accounts
tools.description: Tool to list all WhatsApp accounts in the workspace. Use when you need to view available WhatsApp Business accounts, check which agents are assigned to WhatsApp numbers, or retrieve WhatsApp phone number details.

tools.name: Move Bulk Knowledge Base Items
tools.description: Tool to move multiple documents or folders from one folder to another in the knowledge base. Use when you need to reorganize multiple knowledge base items at once by moving them to a different folder or to the root level.

tools.name: Move ConvAI Knowledge Base Entity
tools.description: Tool to move a knowledge base document or folder to a different folder. Use when you need to reorganize your knowledge base by moving entities between folders or to the root level.

tools.name: Outbound call
tools.description: Tool to place an outbound call via SIP trunk. Use when you need to initiate a voice call through an ElevenLabs agent after obtaining required IDs. Prerequisites: - The API key must have Conversational AI (convai) permissions enabled. For write operations like initiating calls, ensure your API key has the appropriate convai write scope. - A valid SIP trunk phone number must be configured for outbound calls in ElevenLabs. - The SIP trunk must have valid outbound configuration with proper address and credentials. - The agent must be properly configured in the Conversational AI platform.

tools.name: Get API documentation
tools.description: Retrieves the content of the official ElevenLabs API documentation page hosted on Mintlify.

tools.name: Register Twilio Call for ConvAI Agent
tools.description: Tool to register a Twilio call and return TwiML to connect the call to an ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent. Use when you need to integrate ElevenLabs agents with your own Twilio infrastructure for inbound or outbound calls.

tools.name: Remove rules from pronunciation dictionary
tools.description: Permanently removes exact-match pronunciation rules from a specified ElevenLabs pronunciation dictionary using a list of rule strings; non-matching rule strings are ignored and this action cannot add or modify rules.

tools.name: Resubmit Test Invocations
tools.description: Tool to resubmit specific test runs from a test invocation for a conversational AI agent. Use when you need to re-run failed tests or specific test cases from a previous test invocation.

tools.name: Retry Batch Call
tools.description: Tool to retry a batch call, calling failed and no-response recipients again. Use when you need to retry unsuccessful calls from a previous batch calling campaign.

tools.name: Run Agent Tests
tools.description: Tool to run selected tests on a conversational AI agent with optional configuration overrides. Use when you need to execute automated tests on an agent to validate responses, tool calls, or conversation flows. Supports running up to 200 tests in a single invocation with optional branch-specific or configuration override testing.

tools.name: Set Agent Avatar
tools.description: Tool to set or update the avatar image for a Conversational AI agent displayed in the widget. Use when you need to customize the visual appearance of an agent by uploading a profile image.

tools.name: Simulate Conversational AI Agent Conversation
tools.description: Tool to run a simulated conversation between an agent and an AI user. Use when testing agent behavior with specific scenarios or evaluating conversation flow. Returns full transcript with analysis including success metrics and conversation summary.

tools.name: Speech to speech
tools.description: Converts an input audio file to speech using a specified voice; if a `model_id` is provided, it must support speech-to-speech conversion.

tools.name: Speech to speech streaming
tools.description: Converts an input audio stream to a different voice output stream in real-time, using a specified speech-to-speech model.

tools.name: Stream audio isolation
tools.description: Tool to remove background noise from audio and stream the isolated result. Use when you need to clean up audio recordings by isolating vocals/speech and removing unwanted background noise. The audio file must be at least 4.6 seconds long.

tools.name: Stream chapter audio
tools.description: Streams the audio for a specified chapter snapshot from an ElevenLabs project, optionally converting the output to MPEG format.

tools.name: Stream ConvAI agent simulate conversation
tools.description: Tool to run a simulated conversation between an agent and a simulated user, streaming back the response. Response is streamed as partial lists of messages that should be concatenated, with a final message containing conversation analysis once complete.

tools.name: Stream project audio
tools.description: Streams audio from a specific project snapshot, optionally converting it to MPEG format.

tools.name: Archive project snapshot
tools.description: Archives an existing project snapshot by its ID, creating a permanent, immutable, and typically irreversible copy of its state.

tools.name: Submit Batch Call
tools.description: Tool to submit a batch call. Use when you need to initiate multiple calls (voice or WhatsApp) at once. Triggers real outbound calls immediately (if no scheduled_time_unix is set) or at the scheduled time — always confirm recipient list and call count with the user before executing.

tools.name: Text to speech
tools.description: Converts text to speech using a specified ElevenLabs voice and model, returning a downloadable audio file (use ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH_STREAM for streaming instead). Audio URL is nested at `data.file.s3url` in the response. Keep `voice_id`, `model_id`, and `output_format` consistent across all chunks to avoid audible artifacts when concatenating. Some voice/model/format combinations require specific subscription tiers; test with a short sample before full runs. HTTP 429 on burst batches; respect `Retry-After` headers.

tools.name: Text to speech stream
tools.description: Converts text to a spoken audio stream (no saved file or history entry); use the non-streaming text-to-speech tool when a persistent audio URL is needed. Allows latency optimization, specific output formats (some tier-dependent), and custom pronunciations; ensure the chosen model supports text-to-speech and text is preferably under 5000 characters. Keep voice_id, model_id, and output_format consistent across multi-chunk sessions to avoid audio artifacts.

tools.name: Update Audio Native project content
tools.description: Tool to update content for an Audio Native project by uploading a text or HTML file. Use when you need to refresh or change the content of an existing Audio Native project. Optionally auto-convert to audio and auto-publish the new snapshot.

tools.name: Update Conversational AI Agent
tools.description: Tool to update an existing ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent's settings. Use when you need to modify an agent's configuration, such as changing its name, conversation settings, workflow, or platform settings.

tools.name: Update Agent Response Test
tools.description: Tool to update an existing ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent response test by ID. Use when you need to modify test configuration, chat history, success conditions, or other test parameters.

tools.name: Update Knowledge Base Document
tools.description: Tool to update the name of a knowledge base document in ElevenLabs Conversational AI. Use when you need to rename an existing knowledge base document.

tools.name: Update ConvAI Workspace Secret
tools.description: Tool to update an existing secret in the ElevenLabs ConvAI workspace. Use when you need to modify the name or value of an existing API key, token, or other sensitive value stored in the workspace.

tools.name: Update Convai Settings
tools.description: Tool to update Convai settings for the workspace. Use when you need to modify webhook configurations, RAG retention settings, MCP server capabilities, or Livekit stack preferences.

tools.name: Update Convai Dashboard Settings
tools.description: Tool to update Convai dashboard settings for the workspace. Use when you need to configure dashboard charts for monitoring conversational AI performance.

tools.name: Update Conversational AI Tool
tools.description: Tool to update an existing conversational AI tool in ElevenLabs workspace. Use when modifying tool settings, descriptions, API endpoints, or behavior configurations. Requires the complete tool_config object with all required fields for the tool type.

tools.name: Update project pronunciation dictionaries
tools.description: Updates a project's pronunciation dictionaries on ElevenLabs to improve text-to-speech accuracy for specialized terms; note that while multiple dictionaries can be applied, the UI only displays the first.

tools.name: Update pronunciation dictionary
tools.description: Partially updates a pronunciation dictionary's metadata (name or archived status) without changing its version. Use when you need to rename or archive/unarchive a dictionary.

tools.name: Update Workspace Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update a specified workspace webhook by its ID. Use when you need to modify webhook settings such as the display name or enable/disable status.

tools.name: Voice generation parameters retrieval
tools.description: Fetches configurable parameters for ElevenLabs voice generation, used to determine available settings (e.g., accents, character limits) prior to audio synthesis; returns metadata only, not audio.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Eleven Labs API key.

name: Microsoft Teams
description: Microsoft Teams integrates chat, video meetings, and file storage within Microsoft 365, providing virtual collaboration and communication for distributed teams

tools.name: Add chat member
tools.description: Tool to add a conversationMember to a Microsoft Teams chat. Use when adding a user to an existing chat conversation.

tools.name: Add tab to channel
tools.description: Tool to add a new tab to a Microsoft Teams channel. Use when you need to pin an app or website as a tab in a channel.

tools.name: Add member to team
tools.description: Tool to add a user to a Microsoft Teams team. Use when granting or updating membership for a user.

tools.name: Add team members (bulk)
tools.description: Tool to add multiple members to a Microsoft Teams team in a single operation. Use when adding several users at once to improve efficiency.

tools.name: Archive channel
tools.description: Tool to archive a channel in a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to archive a specific channel within a team.

tools.name: Archive team channel
tools.description: Tool to archive a channel in a Microsoft Teams team using the group ID. Use when you need to archive a specific channel within a team.

tools.name: Archive Teams team
tools.description: Tool to archive a Microsoft Teams team. Use after confirming the team ID; returns 202 if accepted.

tools.name: Get all chats
tools.description: Retrieves all Microsoft Teams chats a specified user is part of, supporting filtering, property selection, and pagination.

tools.name: Get all chat messages (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use ListUserChatMessages instead. Retrieves all messages from a specified Microsoft Teams chat using the Microsoft Graph API, automatically handling pagination; ensure `chat_id` is valid and OData expressions in `filter` or `select` are correct.

tools.name: Clear Automatic Location
tools.description: Tool to clear the automatic location from a user's presence in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to remove automatically-set location information from presence status.

tools.name: Clear User Preferred Presence
tools.description: Tool to clear a user's preferred presence setting in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to remove the user's manually set presence status and allow the system to automatically determine their presence based on activity. Supports both delegated (user) and application (S2S) authentication.

tools.name: Clear My Presence (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CLEAR_PRESENCE instead. Tool to clear the authenticated user's presence session in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to remove presence information set by an application for the current user.

tools.name: Clear Presence
tools.description: Tool to clear the presence information for a user's application presence session in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to remove presence information set by an application for the authenticated user. Note: This action can only clear presence for the authenticated user, not for other users.

tools.name: Clear Presence Automatic Location (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CLEAR_AUTOMATIC_LOCATION instead. Tool to clear the automatic presence location for the authenticated user. Use when you need to remove automatically-detected location information from the user's presence status.

tools.name: Clear Presence Location
tools.description: Tool to clear the authenticated user's presence location. Use when you need to remove location information from the user's current presence status.

tools.name: Clone Team
tools.description: Tool to clone a Microsoft Teams team using the team ID. Use when you need to create a copy of an existing team including its structure, channels, and tabs. This is an asynchronous operation; poll the returned location URL to monitor progress.

tools.name: Create Call Operation
tools.description: Tool to create a new operation for a communications call. Use when you need to initiate a new operation on an active call.

tools.name: Create a channel
tools.description: Tool to create a new standard, private, or shared channel within a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to create a new channel for team collaboration.

tools.name: Create Content Sharing Session
tools.description: Tool to create a content sharing session in a Microsoft Teams call. Use when you need to initiate content sharing during an active call.

tools.name: Create channel in group team
tools.description: Tool to create a new channel in a group's associated team. Use when you have a group ID and need to create a channel in its team.

tools.name: Create online meeting
tools.description: Use to schedule a new standalone Microsoft Teams online meeting, i.e., one not linked to any calendar event.

tools.name: Create user offer shift request
tools.description: Tool to create a new offer shift request in a user's joined team schedule. Use when a team member wants to offer their shift to another team member.

tools.name: Create open shifts
tools.description: Tool to create a new open shift in a Microsoft Teams team schedule. Use when you need to publish available shifts that team members can claim.

tools.name: Create open shift change request
tools.description: Tool to create a new open shift change request in a team schedule. Use when a team member wants to claim an available open shift.

tools.name: Create or get online meeting

tools.name: Delete time off request

tools.name: Get chat message

tools.name: Get day note

tools.name: Get channel files folder

tools.name: Get group team channel (Deprecated)

tools.name: Get User Presence

tools.name: Get primary channel

tools.name: Get schedule

tools.name: Get scheduling group

tools.name: Get team member

tools.name: Get installed app in team
tools.description: Tool to get an installed app in a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to retrieve details of a specific app installation.

tools.name: Get Team Template (Deprecated)

tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific time off request from a team's schedule. Use when you need to check the status or details of a time off request.

tools.name: List chats (Deprecated)

tools.name: List chat members (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MICROSOFT_TEAMS_MICROSOFT_TEAMS_USERS_CHATS_LIST_MEMBERS instead. Tool to list members of a Microsoft Teams chat. Use when you need to retrieve the members of a specific one-on-one chat, group chat, or meeting chat.

tools.name: List open shift change requests

tools.name: List users

tools.name: Remove chat member

tools.name: Remove team members
tools.description: Tool to remove multiple members from a Microsoft Teams team in bulk. Use when you need to remove one or more users from a team.

tools.name: Search Teams files
tools.description: Search files in Microsoft Teams using KQL syntax. Find files by name, type, content, author, and modification date across all Teams and channels. Supports boolean logic and date ranges. Examples: 'filetype:pdf AND lastmodifiedtime>=2024-10-01', 'contract AND budget', 'filename:report AND author:user@example.com'

tools.name: Search Teams messages
tools.description: Search Microsoft Teams messages using powerful KQL syntax. Supports sender (from:), date filters (sent:), attachments, and boolean logic. Works across all Teams chats and channels the user has access to. Examples: 'from:user@example.com AND sent>=2024-10-01', 'punchlist OR termination', 'sent>today-30 AND hasattachment:yes' NOTE: This action requires an organizational Microsoft 365 account (Azure AD/Entra ID). It does NOT work with personal Microsoft accounts (MSA) such as @outlook.com, @hotmail.com, or @live.com. If using a personal Microsoft account, this search will fail.

tools.name: Set Presence

tools.name: List chat messages (Deprecated)

tools.name: Send Channel Message

To reply to an existing message thread, use the dedicated reply action instead.

name: Asana
description: Tool to help teams organize, track, and manage their work.

tools.name: Add Followers to Project
tools.description: Tool to add followers to a project in Asana. Use this tool when you need to add one or more users as followers to a specific project. Followers will receive notifications when tasks are added to the project.

tools.name: Add Followers to Task
tools.description: Tool to add followers to a task in Asana. Use this tool when you need to add one or more users as followers to a specific task. This will notify them of updates to the task.

tools.name: Add item to portfolio
tools.description: Add a project (or other supported item) to an Asana portfolio using the native addItem endpoint. Use when a workflow needs to attach a newly created project to a portfolio without using ASANA_SUBMIT_PARALLEL_REQUESTS.

tools.name: Add Members to Project
tools.description: Tool to add users to a project in Asana. Use this tool when you need to add one or more users as members to a specific project. Members can view and contribute to the project.

tools.name: Add Project to Task
tools.description: Tool to add a project to a task in Asana. Use when you need to associate a task with a project. Optionally position the task within the project using insert_before, insert_after, or section parameters.

tools.name: Add Supporting Relationship to Goal
tools.description: Tool to add a supporting goal relationship to a goal. Use when you want to link a project, task, portfolio, or another goal as a supporting resource to a specific goal in Asana.

tools.name: Add Tag to Task
tools.description: Tool to add an existing tag to a task in Asana. Use when you need to add a tag for prioritization, routing, or automation workflows. Tags cannot be added via Update Task, so this dedicated endpoint is required.

tools.name: Add Task Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to add dependency relationships to an Asana task. Use when you need to mark one or more tasks as prerequisites (dependencies) for another task, ensuring the dependency tasks must be completed first.

tools.name: Add task to section
tools.description: Adds an existing task to a section, optionally positioning it before or after another task in that section; if no position is specified, the task is added to the end.

tools.name: Add User for Team
tools.description: Tool to add a user to a team in Asana. Use this when you need to add a user to a specific team by providing their user GID, email, or "me" for the current user.

tools.name: Add User for Workspace
tools.description: Tool to add a user to a workspace or organization in Asana. Use this when you need to add a user to a specific workspace by providing their user GID, email, or "me" for the current user.

tools.name: Approve Access Request
tools.description: Tool to approve an access request in Asana. Use when you need to grant access to a resource that requires approval workflow.

tools.name: Create Access Request
tools.description: Tool to create an access request in Asana. Use when you need to request access to a project or portfolio that you don't currently have access to.

tools.name: Create Allocation
tools.description: Creates a new allocation. Use when you need to schedule or assign a specific amount of a user's time per week to a task or project within a defined period.

tools.name: Create a project
tools.description: Creates a new Asana project in the specified workspace. Requires a `workspace` GID, and additionally a `team` GID if the workspace is an organization.

tools.name: Create a tag in a workspace
tools.description: Creates a new tag, with properties like name and color defined in the request body, within a specific Asana workspace (using `workspace_gid`); this tag helps categorize tasks, is confined to the workspace, and is not automatically applied to tasks.

tools.name: Create task in asana with specific details
tools.description: Creates a new Asana task; requires 'workspace', 'parent', or 'projects' for association, and 'followers', 'projects', 'tags' are set only at creation.

tools.name: Create Attachment for Object
tools.description: Tool to upload an attachment or link an external resource to a task, project, or project_brief in Asana. Use when you need to attach a file or external URL to any Asana object.

tools.name: Create Attachment for Task
tools.description: Tool to upload an attachment to a task. Use when you need to attach a file to a specific task in Asana.

tools.name: Create Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom field in a workspace. Use when you need to define a new field for tracking specific information within Asana tasks.

tools.name: Create Enum Option for Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to create a new enum option for a custom field in Asana. Use this when you need to add a new selectable option to an existing custom field.

tools.name: Create Membership
tools.description: Tool to create a membership by adding a user or team to a project, goal, or portfolio. Use when you need to grant access to an Asana resource.

tools.name: Create Project Brief
tools.description: Tool to create a project brief for a project. Use when you need to add a detailed explanation (what and why) to a project.

tools.name: Create project for team
tools.description: Tool to create a project in a team. Use when you need to create a new project within a specific Asana team.

tools.name: Create project for workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a project in a workspace. Use when you need to create a new project within a specific Asana workspace. Note: The team field is required when creating projects in workspaces.

tools.name: Create Project Status Update
tools.description: Tool to create a new status update on a project. Use when you need to communicate the current status, progress, or any blockers related to a specific project.

tools.name: Create a section in a project
tools.description: Creates a new SECTION (not a task) in a project. Sections are organizational containers within a project used to group and categorize tasks (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done', 'Backlog'). The new section can be optionally positioned relative to an existing section in the same project. IMPORTANT: This action creates SECTIONS only. Do NOT use this action to create tasks. To create a task, use the ASANA_CREATE_A_TASK action instead. Task-related fields like 'assignee', 'notes', 'due_date', 'description' are NOT supported by this action.

tools.name: Create Status Update for Object
tools.description: Tool to create a status update on a project, portfolio, or goal. Use when you need to communicate progress, blockers, or current state to all followers of an object.

tools.name: Create subtask
tools.description: Creates a new Asana subtask under an existing parent task (`task_gid`); `due_on` and `due_at` are mutually exclusive and cannot be set simultaneously.

tools.name: Create a tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new tag in an Asana workspace. Use when you need to create a tag for categorizing tasks. Tags help organize and filter tasks across projects but are not automatically applied to any tasks.

tools.name: Create task comment
tools.description: Adds a new text comment (story) to an existing Asana task, appearing in its activity feed.

tools.name: Create Team
tools.description: Tool to create a new team in an Asana workspace. Use when you need to establish a new team for collaboration.

tools.name: Delete Allocation
tools.description: Tool to delete an allocation by its ID. Use this when you need to remove a specific resource allocation in Asana.

tools.name: Delete Attachment
tools.description: Tool to delete an attachment by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to remove an existing attachment from Asana.

tools.name: Delete Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom field by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to remove an existing custom field from Asana.

tools.name: Delete Membership

tools.description: Delete a project.

tools.name: Delete Project Brief
tools.description: Tool to delete a project brief by its GID. Use when you need to remove a project brief from Asana. Note: This requires the project_brief_gid (not the project_gid).

tools.name: Delete Project Status
tools.description: Tool to delete a project status by its GID. Use when you need to remove a specific project status update from Asana.

tools.name: Delete a section
tools.description: Tool to delete a section by its GID. Use when you need to permanently remove a section from a project.

tools.name: Delete Status Update
tools.description: Tool to delete a status update by its GID. Use when you need to remove a specific status update from Asana.

tools.name: Delete Story
tools.description: Tool to delete a story by its GID. Use when you need to remove a story from Asana.

tools.name: Delete a Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific tag by its GID. Use when you need to remove an existing tag from Asana.

tools.name: Delete a task
tools.description: Delete a task.

tools.name: Duplicate Project
tools.description: Duplicate a project.

tools.name: Duplicate Task
tools.description: Duplicate a task

tools.name: Get Access Requests
tools.description: Tool to retrieve access requests for a target object. Use when you need to get pending access requests for a specific resource like a project or portfolio.

tools.name: Get Allocation
tools.description: Get an allocation by ID. Use when you need to retrieve the details of a specific allocation.

tools.name: Get Allocations
tools.description: Tool to get multiple allocations. Requires either 'parent' (project GID) OR both 'assignee' AND 'workspace' together.

tools.name: Get a project
tools.description: Retrieves a specific Asana project by its `project_gid`, with an option to include additional fields for comprehensive details using `opt_fields`; this action does not return tasks within the project.

tools.name: Get a task
tools.description: Retrieves full details for a specified task GID accessible by the user; use `opt_fields` to customize returned data.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Tool to get a single attachment by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific file attached to a task or project.

tools.name: Get Audit Log Events
tools.description: Tool to get audit log events for a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve a log of actions performed within a specific Asana workspace.

tools.name: Get a user task list
tools.description: Retrieves a specific user's task list from Asana by its `user_task_list_gid`, optionally returning extended details like name, owner, and workspace if specified in `opt_fields`.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's full record, including accessible workspaces, often used as an initial call to establish user context for subsequent operations.

tools.name: Get Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to get a single custom field by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve the complete metadata and properties of a specific custom field in Asana.

tools.name: Get Custom Fields for Workspace
tools.description: Tool to get all custom fields in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve a list of custom fields associated with a specific workspace.

tools.name: Get Custom Types
tools.description: Tool to get all custom types associated with a project. Use when you need to retrieve custom types that extend Asana objects for categorization purposes.

tools.name: Get Events on a Resource
tools.description: Retrieve events on a resource to monitor changes. Use when you need to track activity or changes related to a specific Asana resource like a task, project, or tag.

tools.name: Get Favorites for User
tools.description: Tool to get a user's favorites within a specified workspace. Returns favorites ordered as they appear in the user's Asana sidebar.

tools.name: Get Goal
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for a single goal by its GID.

tools.name: Get Goal Relationships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve goal relationships. Use when you need to get the relationships associated with a specific goal in Asana.

tools.name: Get Goals
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple goals. Requires exactly one scope parameter (workspace, team, portfolio, or project) to be specified. Can be optionally filtered by time period or archived status.

tools.name: Get Job
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a job by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to check the status of asynchronous operations like task duplication, project instantiation, or exports.

tools.name: Get Membership
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single membership by its ID. Use this when you need to get details about a specific membership relationship between a user/team and a goal, project, portfolio, or custom field.

tools.name: Get Memberships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve memberships for goals, projects, portfolios, or custom fields. Use this to find out who has access to a specific Asana resource or what resources a specific user/team has access to.

tools.name: Get multiple projects
tools.description: Returns a list of projects filtered by workspace or team (one required), with optional archived status filter, supporting pagination for large datasets.

tools.name: Get multiple tasks
tools.description: Retrieves a list of tasks, allowing filtering by assignee (requires `workspace`), project, section, `completed_since`, and `modified_since`; `workspace` also requires `assignee`.

tools.name: Get multiple users
tools.description: Returns a list of users in an Asana workspace or organization, optionally filtered by workspace or team GID, with support for pagination and specifying optional fields.

tools.name: Get multiple workspaces
tools.description: Retrieves all workspaces accessible by the authenticated user, returning an empty list if the user has no accessible workspaces.

tools.name: Get Portfolio
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for a single portfolio by its GID. Use this when you need to get detailed information about a specific portfolio.

tools.name: Get Portfolio Items
tools.description: Retrieve items in a portfolio. Use this to get a list of projects or other portfolios contained within a specific portfolio.

tools.name: Get Portfolio Memberships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple portfolio memberships. Use this tool when you need to list memberships for a specific portfolio, a user within a portfolio, or a user across all portfolios in a workspace.

tools.name: Get Portfolios
tools.description: Retrieve multiple portfolios. Use when you need to list portfolios within a specific workspace, optionally filtered by owner.

tools.name: Get Project Brief
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a project brief by its GID. Use when you need to get the detailed explanation (what and why) of a project. Note: Requires the project_brief_gid (not the project_gid). First call 'Get a project' with opt_fields=['project_brief'] to obtain the project_brief_gid.

tools.name: Get Project Membership
tools.description: Tool to get a project membership by ID. Use when you need to retrieve details of a specific project membership.

tools.name: Get Project Memberships For Project
tools.description: Tool to get memberships from a specific project. Use when you need to see who has access to a project and their permission levels.

tools.name: Get Projects for Task
tools.description: Tool to get all projects a task is in. Use when you need to retrieve project associations for a specific task.

tools.name: Get Projects for Team
tools.description: Tool to get a list of projects for a specific team in Asana. Use when you need to retrieve project details associated with a team.

tools.name: Get Project Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full record for a single project status by its GID. Use when you need to get the details of a specific project status update.

tools.name: Get Project Status Updates
tools.description: Tool to get status updates for a specific project. Use when you need to retrieve the latest or historical status reports associated with an Asana project.

tools.name: Get Multiple Project Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple project templates. Use when you need to list available project templates in a workspace or team.

tools.name: Get Project Templates for Team
tools.description: Tool to get a team's project templates in Asana. Use when you need to retrieve project templates associated with a specific team.

tools.name: Get Reactions on Object
tools.description: Tool to get reactions with a specific emoji base character on an object. Use when you need to retrieve user reactions (emoji responses) on a status update or story.

tools.name: Get Section
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for a single section by its GID. Use this when you need to get details about a specific section within a project.

tools.name: Get sections in a project
tools.description: Returns compact records for all sections (used to group tasks) in a specified project.

tools.name: Get Status Update
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full record for a single status update by its GID. Use when you need to get the details of a specific status update.

tools.name: Get Status Updates
tools.description: Retrieve status updates from an object. Use when you need to get the latest or historical status updates for a specific project, portfolio, or goal.

tools.name: Get Stories for Task
tools.description: Tool to get stories (comments, status updates, etc.) for a task. Use when you need to retrieve the history or discussion associated with a specific task.

tools.name: Get Story
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a story. Use when you need to get the complete record for a single story.

tools.name: Get Tag
tools.description: Tool to get a single tag by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific tag.

tools.name: Get Tags
tools.description: Get multiple tags in a workspace.

tools.name: Get Tags for Task
tools.description: Tool to get all tags associated with a specific task. Use when you need to retrieve tags for categorization, filtering, or understanding task organization.

tools.name: Get Tags For Workspace
tools.description: Tool to get all tags in a specific workspace. Use when you need to retrieve tags for categorizing tasks within a workspace.

tools.name: Get Task Attachments
tools.description: Tool to get the list of attachments for a given task, project, or project_brief. Use when you need to retrieve files attached to a specific Asana object.

tools.name: Get Task Counts For Project
tools.description: Tool to get task count statistics for a project. Use when you need to retrieve the number of tasks, completed tasks, incomplete tasks, and milestone counts for a specific Asana project. Note that all fields are excluded by default - you must specify them in opt_fields to get any data.

tools.name: Get tasks for tag
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tasks associated with a specific Asana tag by tag GID. Use when you need to list all tasks that have been tagged with a particular label.

tools.name: Get tasks for user task list
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tasks from a user task list by user task list GID. Use when you need to list tasks assigned to a specific user's task list.

tools.name: Retrieve tasks for project
tools.description: Retrieves tasks from a specified Asana project, allowing filtering by completion status and selection of optional fields for detailed responses.

tools.name: Get tasks from a section
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tasks that belong to a specific Asana section (column/header) by section GID. Use when you need to list tasks within a particular section, such as for agenda or carryover workflows. Board view only feature.

tools.name: Get Task Subtasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple task subtasks from a workspace. Use when you need to list or find available task subtasks.

tools.name: Get Task Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple task templates from a workspace. Use when you need to list or find available task templates.

tools.name: Get Team
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific team by its GID. Use when you need to fetch information about a particular team in Asana.

tools.name: Get Team Membership
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a complete team membership record by its GID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific team membership in Asana.

tools.name: Get Team Memberships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve compact team membership records. Use when you need to list members of a team, teams a user belongs to, or all team memberships in a workspace.

tools.name: Get Team Memberships for Team
tools.description: Tool to get memberships from a specific team. Use when you need to retrieve the list of users who are members of a particular team, including their membership details such as admin status and guest status.

tools.name: Get Team Memberships For User
tools.description: Tool to get team memberships for a specific user. Use when you need to retrieve all teams that a user belongs to within a workspace.

tools.name: Get Teams for User
tools.description: Tool to get teams for a specific user in an organization. Returns the team records for all teams in the organization or workspace to which the given user is assigned.

tools.name: Get teams in workspace
tools.description: Returns the compact records for all teams in the workspace visible to the authorized user.

tools.name: Get Time Period
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full record for a single time period by its GID. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific time period, including its start/end dates, display name, and parent period.

tools.name: Get Time Periods
tools.description: Tool to retrieve compact or full representations of time periods. Use this when you need to fetch information about specific time periods, such as their start and end dates, display names, and parent periods.

tools.name: Get Time Tracking Entries
tools.description: Tool to get multiple time tracking entries across workspace, tasks, or projects. Use when you need to retrieve time tracking information for filtering by workspace, task, portfolio, user, or date range.

tools.name: Get Time Tracking Entries for Task
tools.description: Tool to get time tracking entries for a task. Use when you need to retrieve time tracking information recorded on a specific task.

tools.name: Get Objects via Typeahead
tools.description: Tool to retrieve objects in a workspace via a typeahead search algorithm. Use when you need to quickly find objects like tasks, projects, users, etc., based on a search string. This is useful for implementing auto-completion features.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Get a user by their ID.

tools.name: Get User in Workspace
tools.description: Tool to get a user in a workspace or organization by their GID. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific user within a workspace context.

tools.name: Get Users for Team
tools.description: Get users in a team.

tools.name: Get Users in Workspace
tools.description: Get users in a workspace or organization.

tools.name: Get User Task List
tools.description: Tool to get a single user task list by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve information about a specific user's My Tasks list.

tools.name: Get Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple webhooks in a workspace. Use when you need to list all webhooks for a workspace or filter webhooks by a specific resource.

tools.name: Get Workspace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific workspace by its GID. Use when you need to get information about a particular Asana workspace.

tools.name: Get Workspace Membership
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific workspace membership by its GID. Use when you need to get details about a user's membership in a workspace.

tools.name: Get Workspace Memberships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the workspace memberships for a specific workspace. Use when you need to list members of a workspace.

tools.name: Get Workspace Memberships For User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve workspace memberships for a specific user. Use when you need to list all workspaces a user is a member of.

tools.name: Get Workspace Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the projects associated with a specific workspace. Use when you need to list all projects within a given Asana workspace.

tools.name: Reorder Enum Option for Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to reorder an existing enum option within a custom field by moving it before or after another specified enum option. Use when you need to change the order/position of options in an enum or multi_enum custom field. Note: To create new enum options, use 'Create Enum Option for Custom Field' action instead.

tools.name: Move or Insert Section in Project
tools.description: Tool to move or reorder an existing section within a project by repositioning it before or after another section. Use when you need to change the position/order of sections in a project. Note: This action moves existing sections only. To create new sections, use 'Create Section in Project' action instead.

tools.name: Instantiate Project Template
tools.description: Instantiate (create) a real Asana project from a project template, returning the async job record. Use when you need to create a new project from a template with specific date and role assignments.

tools.name: Reject access request

tools.name: Remove Follower From Task
tools.description: Tool to remove one or more followers from a task. Use when you need to update the list of users following a specific task.

tools.name: Remove Followers For Project
tools.description: Tool to remove followers from a project in Asana. Use when you need to remove one or more users as followers from a specific project.

tools.name: Remove Members from Project

tools.name: Remove User For Team

tools.name: Remove User from Workspace
tools.description: Tool to remove a user from a workspace or organization. Use when you need to revoke a user's access to a specific workspace.

tools.name: Search Tasks in Workspace
tools.description: Tool to search tasks across a workspace with advanced filters. Use when performing complex queries such as overdue tasks, by project or custom field, for reporting or automation.

tools.name: Set parent for task
tools.description: Tool to set the parent of a task in Asana. Use when you need to make a task a subtask of another task or remove the parent relationship.

tools.name: Submit Parallel Requests (Batch API)
tools.description: Tool to submit multiple Asana API requests in parallel using the Batch API. Use when you need to perform several operations efficiently, such as fetching multiple tasks or creating multiple subtasks at once.

tools.name: Update Allocation
tools.description: Tool to update an existing allocation by its ID. Use this when you need to modify details like the start date, end date, effort, or assignee for an allocation.

tools.name: Update a task
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing Asana task identified by its task_gid.

tools.name: Update Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to update a custom field by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing custom field in Asana.

tools.name: Update Enum Option
tools.description: Tool to update an enum option for a custom field. Use when you need to modify the name, color, or enabled status of an existing enum option.

tools.description: Update a section's name or position within a project. Use when you need to rename a section or reorder sections by specifying insert_before or insert_after.

name: People Data Labs
description: PeopleDataLabs provides B2B data enrichment and identity resolution, empowering organizations to build enriched user profiles and validate customer information

tools.name: Clean company data
tools.description: Cleans and standardizes company information based on a name, website, or profile URL; providing at least one of these inputs is highly recommended for meaningful results.

tools.name: Clean company data (POST)
tools.description: Tool to clean and standardize company data using POST method. Use when you need to standardize company information by providing company name, website, or social profile. Returns standardized company information including name, website, LinkedIn profile, and other company identifiers.

tools.name: Clean location data
tools.description: Cleans and standardizes a raw, unformatted location string into a structured representation, provided the input is a recognizable geographical place.

tools.name: Clean location data (POST)
tools.description: Tool to clean and standardize location data using POST method. Use when you need to normalize raw location strings into structured location information including city, region, and country.

tools.name: Clean school data
tools.description: Cleans and standardizes school information; provide at least one of the school's name, website, or profile for optimal results.

tools.name: Clean school data (POST)
