name: Radar
description: Radar is a full-stack location infrastructure platform offering SDKs and APIs for geofencing, location tracking, geocoding, search, routing, and maps.

tools.name: Autocomplete Address or Place
tools.description: Tool to autocomplete partial addresses and place names based on relevance and proximity. Use after a user inputs a partial address/place to get suggestions, optionally biased by location.

tools.name: Create Beacon
tools.description: Tool to create a new beacon in Radar. Use when you need to register a physical beacon device (iBeacon or Eddystone) for location tracking.

tools.name: Create Trip
tools.description: Tool to create a new trip. Use after gathering origin and destination details to start tracking a trip.

tools.name: Delete Beacon
tools.description: Tool to delete a beacon by its Radar ID. Use when supplying a beacon's unique identifier to remove it.

tools.name: Delete Geofence
tools.description: Tool to delete a geofence by ID. Use when supplying a geofence’s unique identifier to remove it.

tools.name: Delete Geofence By Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a geofence by tag and external ID. Use when you have both the tag and external identifier to remove a specific geofence.

tools.name: Delete Trip
tools.description: Tool to delete a trip by its Radar ID or external ID. Use after confirming the trip exists.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Tool to delete a user by Radar _id, userId, or deviceId. Use after confirming the user identifier exists.

tools.name: Forward Geocode
tools.description: Tool to convert an address into geographic coordinates. Use when you have a full address string and need precise latitude/longitude before further location analysis.

tools.name: Get Beacon
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a beacon by Radar _id. Use when you need to fetch full details of an existing beacon.

tools.name: Get Beacon By Tag
tools.description: Tool to get a specific beacon by tag and external ID. Use when you need to retrieve details of a beacon identified by its tag group and external ID.

tools.name: Get Context for Location
tools.description: Tool to retrieve context for a given location. Use when you need geofences, place, and region information based on coordinates. Use after obtaining valid latitude and longitude.

tools.name: Get Geofence
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a geofence by Radar _id or tag/externalId. Use when you need to fetch full details of an existing geofence.

tools.name: Get Places Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current Places settings for your Radar project. Use when you need to inspect chain detection, supported countries, external ID requirements, and other Places metadata.

tools.name: Get Route Directions
tools.description: Tool to get turn-by-turn directions between multiple locations. Use when you need detailed navigation instructions with steps, distances, and durations for routing.

tools.name: Get Route Matrix
tools.description: Tool to calculate travel distance and duration between multiple origins and destinations for up to 625 routes. Use when you need to compute route metrics for multiple origin-destination pairs efficiently.

tools.name: Get Trip
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a trip by ID or externalId. Use when you have a trip ID or externalId to fetch its details.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to get a user by Radar _id, userId, or deviceId. Returns the user with all location and context data including geofences, places, beacons, and trip information.

tools.name: Get Users in Geofence
tools.description: Tool to retrieve users currently within a specific geofence. Use when you need to list all users inside a geofence by its tag and external ID.

tools.name: IP Geocode
tools.description: Tool to geocode an IP address to city, state, and country. Use when you need location details based on an IP address.

tools.name: List Events
tools.description: Tool to list events. Use when you need to retrieve a paginated list of events with optional filtering.

tools.name: List Geofences
tools.description: Tool to list all geofences sorted by updated time. Use when you need an overview of all configured geofences.

tools.name: List Trips
tools.description: Tool to list all trips, sorted by updated time. Use when you need to page through the latest trips.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Tool to list Radar users sorted by update time. Use when you need to page through users in your project.

tools.name: Reverse Geocode
tools.description: Tool to convert geographic coordinates to structured addresses. Use when you have latitude/longitude and need a human-readable address.

tools.name: Route Distance
tools.description: Tool to compute distance and travel time between origins and destinations. Use when you need route metrics before optimizing or timing routes.

tools.name: Search Geofences
tools.description: Tool to search for geofences near a given location. Use when you need to find geofences within a radius of specified coordinates.

tools.name: Search Places Near Location
tools.description: Tool to search for places near given coordinates. Use when you need to find points of interest around a location.

tools.name: Search Users Near Location
tools.description: Tool to search for users near a location. Use after obtaining coordinates when you need to retrieve users within a given radius.

tools.name: Track Location Update
tools.description: Tool to track a user's location update. Use when sending a location update for a user, creating or updating user and event data.

tools.name: Update Places Settings
tools.description: Tool to update Places settings for your Radar project including chain metadata preferences. Use when you need to configure chain detection or other Places settings.

tools.name: Update Trip
tools.description: Tool to update a trip. Use when you need to modify mode, destination, schedule, or active status.

tools.name: Update Trip By ID
tools.description: Tool to update a trip status by Radar _id or external ID. Use when you need to change trip status to started, approaching, arrived, completed, or canceled.

tools.name: Upsert Beacon by ID
tools.description: Tool to create or update a beacon by Radar _id. Use when you need to ensure a beacon with a specific ID exists with updated properties.

tools.name: Upsert Beacon by Tag
tools.description: Tool to create or update a beacon by tag and externalId. Use when you need to ensure a beacon exists or is updated with specific identifiers.

tools.name: Upsert Geofence
tools.description: Tool to create or update a geofence by tag and externalId. Use when ensuring a geofence exists or is updated based on identifiers.

tools.name: Upsert Geofence By ID
tools.description: Tool to create or update a geofence by Radar _id. Use when you need to upsert a geofence using its internal Radar identifier.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Radar API key, used for authenticating API requests.

name: Ragic
description: Ragic is a web-based database builder that allows users to create and manage databases as easily as creating a spreadsheet.

tools.name: Delete Entry
tools.description: Tool to delete an entry from a Ragic sheet. Use when you need to remove a specific record from a sheet by its record ID.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Tool to download uploaded files, images, or email attachments from Ragic. Use the file reference returned from API responses (e.g., from record fields).

tools.name: Get Action Buttons
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available action buttons on a Ragic sheet. Returns action button IDs and names. Use category=massOperation to get buttons available for mass operations.

tools.name: Get Custom Print Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a custom print report for a Ragic record in various formats (pdf, png, docx). Use when you need to generate and download a formatted report using a specific template.

tools.name: Get Entry
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single entry from a Ragic sheet by its record ID. Use when you need to fetch specific record data including field values and optional subtable data.

tools.name: Get Record as PDF
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a PDF version of a Ragic record. Use when you need to export or download a record in PDF format. The PDF will contain the full record data in a formatted document.

tools.name: Search Records
tools.description: Search Records

required.name: subdomain
required.description: The server location for your Ragic account, such as 'na3', 'ap5', or 'eu2'.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Ragic API key, obtainable from Personal Settings > Profile.

name: Ragie
description: Fully managed RAG-as-a-Service for developers

tools.name: Create Document
tools.description: Tool to upload and process a document file in Ragie. Use when you need to create a new document with support for various formats including text, images, and documents. The endpoint accepts multipart/form-data and returns a Document object with processing status and metadata.

tools.name: Create Document From URL
tools.description: Tool to ingest a document from a publicly accessible URL. Use when you need to add documents to Ragie from external sources. The document undergoes processing steps (pending, partitioning, indexed, ready) before becoming available for retrieval.

tools.name: Create Document Raw
tools.description: Tool to ingest a document as raw text or JSON. Use when creating a new document from text or JSON data. The document goes through processing steps and becomes available for retrieval once in the ready state.

tools.name: Create Instruction
tools.description: Tool to create a new instruction that applies natural language directives to documents as they're ingested or updated. Use when you need to define structured data extraction or analysis rules for documents in Ragie.

tools.name: Create OAuth Redirect URL
tools.description: Tool to create an OAuth redirect URL for initializing embedded connector OAuth flows. Use when you need to set up OAuth authentication for connectors like Google Drive, Notion, or HubSpot.

tools.name: Create Partition
tools.description: Tool to create a new partition for scoping documents and connections in Ragie. Use when you need to organize documents and set resource limits for different workspaces or tenants.

tools.name: Delete Document
tools.description: Tool to delete a document from Ragie. Use when you need to remove a document permanently from the system. Supports both synchronous and asynchronous deletion modes.

tools.name: Delete Instruction
tools.description: Tool to delete an instruction and all associated entities. Use when you need to permanently remove an instruction (irreversible operation). Requires the instruction ID (UUID format).

tools.name: Delete Partition
tools.description: Tool to delete a partition and all associated data irreversibly. Use when you need to permanently remove a partition. Returns status 200 for synchronous deletion or 202 for asynchronous deletion.

tools.name: Get Document
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific document by its unique identifier. Use when you need to get document details, metadata, processing status, or check for errors. Returns comprehensive document information including chunk count, page count, and any processing errors.

tools.name: Get Document Chunk
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific document chunk by its document and chunk ID. Use when you need detailed information about a specific chunk within a document, including its content, metadata, position index, and optional modality data for audio/video chunks.

tools.name: Get Document Chunk Content
tools.description: Tool to retrieve document chunk content in requested format with streaming support for media. Use when you need to get the actual content of a specific chunk from a document.

tools.name: Get Document Chunks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve document chunks with pagination support. Lists all document chunks sorted by index in ascending order (max 100 items per page). Documents created prior to 9/18/2024 that have not been updated since have chunks sorted by ID instead of index.

tools.name: Get Document Content
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the content of a document by its ID. Use when you need to access the full content of a specific document. The media_type parameter can be used to request content in different formats.

tools.name: Get Document Summary
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an LLM-generated summary of a document by its ID. Use when you need to get a concise summary of a document's content.

tools.name: Get Partition
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a partition by ID with usage statistics and resource limits. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific partition.

tools.name: Get Response
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a response by its unique identifier. Use when you need to check the status or details of a previously created response.

tools.name: List Connections
tools.description: Tool to list all connections sorted by creation date descending with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve connections, optionally filtered by metadata.

tools.name: List Connection Source Types
tools.description: Tool to list available connection source types like 'google_drive' and 'notion' along with their metadata. Use when you need to discover what connector types are available in Ragie.

tools.name: List Documents
tools.description: Tool to list all documents sorted by creation date (descending) with pagination support. Use when you need to browse or retrieve document metadata. Supports filtering and pagination up to 100 items per page.

tools.name: List Entities By Document
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all extracted entities from a specific document with pagination support. Use when you need to access structured data that has been extracted from a document by Ragie's entity extraction instructions.

tools.name: List Entities by Instruction
tools.description: Tool to retrieve entities generated by a specific instruction. Use when you need to fetch entities extracted from documents based on a specific instruction's processing.

tools.name: List Instructions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all instruction records from the Ragie system. Use when you need to view all available instructions that define natural language prompts and entity schemas applied to documents.

tools.name: List Partitions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all partitions sorted by name in ascending order. Use when you need to list available partitions with their configurations and limits.

tools.name: Patch Document Metadata
tools.description: Tool to update metadata for a specific document with partial update support. Use when you need to modify document metadata fields without replacing the entire metadata object. Supports both synchronous and asynchronous updates.

tools.name: Retrieve Document Chunks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve relevant document chunks based on a query. Use when you need to search and retrieve document content that matches a specific query, with optional filtering and reranking capabilities.

tools.name: Set Partition Limits
tools.description: Tool to set usage limits on partition pages and media. Use when you need to configure monthly or maximum limits for pages processed/hosted, video/audio processing, or media streaming/hosting for a specific partition.

tools.name: Update Document From URL
tools.description: Tool to update an existing document by fetching content from a publicly accessible URL. Use when you need to refresh or replace a document's content with data from a web URL. The document goes through processing steps before it is ready for retrieval.

tools.name: Update Document Raw
tools.description: Tool to update a document's content from raw text or JSON data. Use when modifying existing document content. The document undergoes processing and becomes available for retrieval once it reaches the ready state.

tools.name: Update Instruction
tools.description: Tool to update an instruction's active status. Use when you need to activate or deactivate an existing instruction.

tools.name: Update Partition
tools.description: Tool to update a partition's configuration including description, context-aware settings, and metadata schema. Use when you need to modify an existing partition's settings.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in and copy your API key directly from your dashboard under API Keys (https://secure.ragie.ai/api-keys)

name: Raisely
description: Raisely is a fundraising platform that enables organizations to create and manage online fundraising campaigns.

tools.name: Check Profile URL Availability
tools.description: Tool to verify if a profile URL is available for a given campaign and get suggestions if unavailable. Use when creating a new profile to ensure the desired URL path is not already taken, or to get alternative path suggestions.

tools.name: Check User Registration
tools.description: Tool to check if a user is already registered to a campaign with a specific email address. Use when validating sign-up forms to prompt existing users to log in instead of creating duplicate accounts.

tools.name: Create Campaign
tools.description: Tool to create a new campaign in Raisely. Use when you need to create a new fundraising campaign or clone an existing one.

tools.name: Create Offline Donation
tools.description: Tool to record an offline donation in Raisely. Use when recording donations that were processed externally (outside of Raisely's payment flow). These donations are marked with type=OFFLINE to indicate they were processed elsewhere.

tools.name: Create Exercise Log
tools.description: Tool to create a new exercise log in Raisely. Use when you need to record physical activity data for a user, such as running, cycling, or swimming. Requires userUuid and profileUuid.

tools.name: Create Interaction
tools.description: Tool to create a new interaction in Raisely. Use when you need to record an interaction event. Either categoryUuid or categoryPath must be provided.

tools.name: Create Post
tools.description: Create a new post in Raisely. Use when you need to add a blog post or update to a profile or campaign.

tools.name: Create Promo Code
tools.description: Tool to create a new promo code in Raisely. Use when you need to add discount codes for campaigns, create promotional offers, or set up limited-time discounts.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to add a new webhook to your Raisely account. Use when you need to subscribe to event notifications. By default, webhooks trigger for events across all campaigns unless a specific campaignUuid is provided.

tools.name: Delete Exercise Log
tools.description: Tool to delete an exercise log from Raisely. Use when you need to remove a specific exercise log record by its UUID. Returns the deleted exercise log data for confirmation.

tools.name: Delete Interaction
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing custom interaction from Raisely. Use when you need to remove a custom interaction by its UUID. Cannot delete system-generated or read-only interactions.

tools.name: Delete Raisely Post
tools.description: Tool to delete a post from the Raisely platform. Use when you need to permanently remove a blog post by its path or UUID. Returns the deleted post record upon successful deletion.

tools.name: Delete Profile
tools.description: Tool to archive a profile in Raisely. Archived profiles are hidden from the campaign but not permanently deleted. Use when a fundraiser wants to remove their profile from public view or when cleaning up campaign profiles.

tools.name: Delete Raisely Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook from the Raisely platform. Use when you need to permanently remove a webhook subscription by its UUID. Returns the deleted webhook record upon successful deletion.

tools.name: Retrieve Raisely API Documentation Summary
tools.description: Retrieve a summary of the Raisely API documentation including metadata and sample endpoints. Returns the OpenAPI version, API info (title, version, description, contact), and a sample of available paths. Use this to understand the general structure of the Raisely API.

tools.name: Authenticate Token
tools.description: Authenticate a token to confirm it's valid and check the logged-in user. Use to verify token validity, get the authenticated user's details, and find the organisation UUID for future requests.

tools.name: Get Available Events
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of available Raisely webhook events. Use when you need to know all event types Raisely can send via webhooks.

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific campaign from Raisely. Use when you need to get details for a single campaign by UUID, path, or domain.

tools.name: Get Campaign Profile
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the campaign profile for a Raisely campaign. The campaign profile is the top-level profile for all profiles in the campaign. It is hidden from the fundraising website, but will have the same name, path, and goal as your campaign.

tools.name: Get campaigns
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of campaigns from Raisely. Use when you need to list campaigns after obtaining a valid API token.

tools.name: List Campaign Profiles
tools.description: List all fundraising profiles in a Raisely campaign. Profiles represent individuals, teams, or organizations participating in a fundraising campaign. Returns profile details including name, fundraising goal, amount raised, and associated user information. Supports search, pagination, and sorting. Use 'limit' and 'offset' for paging through large result sets.

tools.name: Get Exercise Log
tools.description: Retrieve a specific exercise log by UUID from the Raisely platform. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a particular exercise activity.

tools.name: Get Interaction
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific interaction from Raisely by its UUID. Use when you need to fetch details about a particular interaction record.

tools.name: Get Post
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific post from the Raisely fundraising platform. Use when you need to fetch details of a single post by its UUID or path.

tools.name: Get Profile
tools.description: Retrieves a specific fundraising profile from Raisely by UUID or path. Use this tool to get detailed information about an individual, team, or organisation profile including fundraising totals, activity metrics, goals, and associated user information. Set private=true to access private custom fields when authenticated with proper permissions.

tools.name: Raisely Get Profiles
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of fundraising profiles for a Raisely campaign. Use this tool to: - List all fundraisers (profiles) in a campaign - Search for specific profiles by name or description - Filter profiles by user or organisation - Rank profiles by amount raised, donor count, or activity metrics - Paginate through large result sets The 'campaign' parameter is required and accepts a campaign UUID, path, or domain.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific user from Raisely by UUID. Use when you need detailed information about a single user including their contact details, admin status, and custom fields.

tools.name: Get User Profiles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all profiles associated with a specific user. Use when you have a user UUID and need to list both public and optionally private profiles.

tools.name: Get Users
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users from the Raisely platform. Returns all users in the organisation with optional pagination, sorting, and private data. Use the 'private' parameter to include sensitive user details like email, address, and phone number. Default limit is 100 records. Use 'offset' for pagination through large result sets.

tools.name: List Campaign Donations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve donations from a specific campaign in Raisely. Returns a paginated list of donations in descending order by creation date (most recent first) unless otherwise specified. Use this when you need to view donation history, track fundraising progress, or analyze donor patterns for a campaign.

tools.name: List Campaign Products
tools.description: Retrieves all products available in a Raisely campaign. Use this to list tickets, merchandise, or other items configured for sale in a specific campaign. Products include details such as price, availability, and stock information.

tools.name: List Campaign Subscriptions
tools.description: List all subscriptions for a specific Raisely campaign. Returns a paginated list of recurring donation subscriptions with detailed payment and subscriber information. Use when you need to retrieve subscriptions for a specific campaign by campaign UUID, path, or domain. Supports filtering by status, mode, source, user, and search queries, with sorting and pagination options.

tools.name: Raisely List Donations
tools.description: Retrieve donations from Raisely. Returns a paginated list of all donations in descending order of creation time (unless specified otherwise). Use this to view donation history, analyze giving patterns, or track specific donations by status, campaign, or user. Supports extensive filtering and sorting options.

tools.name: Raisely List Exercise Logs
tools.description: Retrieve exercise logs from Raisely. Returns a paginated list of exercise logs you've previously created, in descending order of when they were created unless specified otherwise. Use this to view exercise activities, track fitness progress, or analyze activity data for fundraising campaigns.

tools.name: List Interaction Categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all interaction categories in the organisation from Raisely. Use when you need to list available interaction categories for categorizing supporter interactions, such as phone calls, emails, or meetings. Supports search, filtering, sorting, and pagination.

tools.name: List Interactions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all interactions from Raisely. Use when you need to list user interactions, track engagement history, or audit activity records. Supports filtering by user, category, and text search with pagination and sorting options.

tools.name: List Orders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all orders in a campaign from Raisely. Use when you need to list orders, view order details, or analyze purchase data. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination.

tools.name: List Posts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of posts you've previously created on Raisely. Posts are returned in descending order of creation date by default, unless you specify otherwise using the 'sort' and 'order' parameters.

tools.name: List Profile Donations
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of donations for a specific fundraising profile from Raisely. Returns donations in descending order of creation date by default (most recent first). Use this tool to: - View all donations received by a specific fundraiser profile - Track donation history for reporting and analysis - Search for specific donations by donor information - Filter donations by status, type, currency, or other criteria - Monitor suspicious or fraudulent donations for a profile

tools.name: List Profile Members
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all members belonging to a team profile in Raisely. Use this tool when you need to list all individual fundraisers who are members of a specific team. The 'path' parameter is required and accepts either the team profile's UUID or its path/slug.

tools.name: List Profile Posts
tools.description: List all posts created by a specific profile in Raisely. Returns posts in descending order of creation date by default (newest first). Use when you need to retrieve a profile's activity feed or blog posts.

tools.name: List Promo Codes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all promo codes in a campaign from Raisely. Use when you need to list available discount codes, view promo code details, or check usage statistics for promotional campaigns.

tools.name: List Segments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all segments from Raisely. Use when you need to list previously created segments, view segment definitions, or filter segments by sharing status. Results are returned in descending order of creation time unless specified otherwise.

tools.name: Raisely List Subscriptions 2
tools.description: Tool to retrieve subscriptions from Raisely. Returns a list of subscriptions you've previously created in descending order of creation time. Use when you need to view subscription history, analyze recurring donation patterns, or filter subscriptions by status, campaign, user, or other criteria.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of tags from Raisely. Use when you need to fetch all available tags for categorization or filtering purposes. Note that tags flagged as private will not be included unless the 'private' parameter is set to true (requires authentication).

tools.name: List User Donations
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of donations for a specific user from Raisely. Returns donations in descending order of creation date by default (most recent first). Use this to view all donations created by or associated with a specific user.

tools.name: List User Interactions
tools.description: Retrieves all interactions for a given user from Raisely. Returns a paginated list of user activities including donations, profile updates, comments, and other events. Use this to track user engagement and activity history. Supports filtering by category, search queries, and pagination options.

tools.name: Raisely List User Subscriptions
tools.description: Retrieve subscriptions for a specific user from Raisely. Returns a paginated list of subscriptions in descending order of creation time (unless specified otherwise). Use this to view recurring donation patterns for a specific user, identify their active subscriptions, or track subscription history.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of webhooks configured for a campaign. Use when you need to list all webhook subscriptions for a specific campaign after authenticating.

tools.name: Move Donation
tools.description: Tool to move a donation to a different profile in Raisely. Use when you need to reassign a donation from one fundraiser or campaign profile to another. The target profile may be in a different campaign.

tools.name: Logout from Raisely
tools.description: Tool to invalidate the current user's token and log out. Use when ending an authenticated Raisely session to ensure the token is invalidated.

tools.name: Create User
tools.description: Create a new user in Raisely. Fails if a user with the same email already exists. Use for adding new users to your organization's user database.

tools.name: Update Campaign
tools.description: Tool to update an existing campaign in Raisely. Use when you need to modify campaign settings like name, goal, mode, or custom fields. The campaign can be identified by its UUID, path, or domain. Only provide the fields you want to update.

tools.name: Update Campaign Config
tools.description: Tool to update a specific configuration attribute for a campaign in Raisely. Use when you need to modify campaign settings or custom configuration values.

tools.name: Update Exercise Log
tools.description: Update an existing exercise log in Raisely. Use when you need to modify distance, time, activity type, or other details of a logged exercise.

tools.name: Update Post
tools.description: Tool to update a specified post in Raisely. Use when you need to modify an existing post's title, body, date, path, or photo URL. Requires the post's UUID or path identifier.

tools.name: Update Profile
tools.description: Updates a specific profile in Raisely. Use when you need to modify profile details like description, goal, name, photo, or custom fields.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update a specified user in Raisely. Use when you need to modify an existing user's profile information, contact details, or custom fields.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update a specified webhook in Raisely. Use when you need to modify an existing webhook's URL, events, or secret. Requires the webhook's UUID identifier.

tools.name: Upload Campaign Media
tools.description: Tool to upload one or more files to a campaign's media library in Raisely. Use when you need to add images, documents, or other media files to a specific campaign folder.

tools.name: Upsert User
tools.description: Tool to upsert a user record in Raisely, optionally tagging and creating an interaction. Use when accepting form submissions or creating/updating user records. Creates a new user if the email doesn't exist, or updates the existing user if it does.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The private key for your Raisely campaign, providing admin access.

name: Ramp
description: Ramp is a platform that helps you manage your finances, track your income and expenses, and get insights into your business

tools.name: Create Department
tools.description: Tool for creating a new department in your Ramp organization. Perfect for setting up organizational structure and expense categorization.

tools.name: Create Inventory Item Accounting Field
tools.description: Tool to create a new inventory item accounting field for tracking inventory categories. Use when setting up inventory tracking for an accounting connection. Note: There can only be one active inventory item accounting field per accounting connection.

tools.name: Create Transaction Memo
tools.description: Tool for uploading a new memo for a transaction in Ramp. Use when you need to add notes or context to existing transactions.

tools.name: Create Mileage Reimbursement
tools.description: Tool to create a mileage reimbursement in Ramp. Use when a user needs to submit a reimbursement for business-related travel distance. Requires distance, reimbursee_id, and trip_date as mandatory fields.

tools.name: Create New Custom Accounting Field
tools.description: Tool for creating a new custom accounting field. Note: This operation requires elevated permissions not available in the demo API.

tools.name: Create Tax Code Accounting Field
tools.description: Tool to create a new tax code accounting field in Ramp. There can only be one active tax code accounting field per accounting connection. Use when you need to set up tax code tracking for an accounting integration.

tools.name: Create User Invite
tools.description: Tool to create a user invite for onboarding new employees to Ramp. Triggers an async task to send an invite email. Users must accept the invite to be onboarded. Assign users to specific entities using location_id.

tools.name: Create Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook subscription for receiving event notifications from Ramp. Use when you need to set up real-time notifications for events like transactions, bills, or reimbursements. The newly registered subscription will be in pending verification state and requires endpoint verification with the provided challenge.

tools.name: Deactivate User
tools.description: Tool to deactivate a user in your Ramp organization. Use when you need to prevent a user from logging in, spending on cards, or receiving notifications. Once deactivated, users cannot access their Ramp account or perform any actions.

tools.name: Delete Accounting GL Account
tools.description: Tool to delete a general ledger account from Ramp. Use when you need to remove a GL account from the accounting system.

tools.name: Delete Accounting Connection
tools.description: Tool to disconnect the current active API-based accounting connection. Use when you need to disable the accounting integration. This action will clear associated accounting settings including Custom Fields, GL Accounts, and Vendors. Only API-based connections can be disconnected via this endpoint.

tools.name: Delete Custom Accounting Field
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom accounting field from Ramp. Use when you need to remove a custom accounting field from the system. Note: Fields are read-only and cannot be deleted when a direct accounting connection is enabled.

tools.name: Delete Accounting Inventory Item Option
tools.description: Tool to delete an accounting inventory item option from Ramp. Use when you need to remove an inventory item option from the accounting system.

tools.name: Delete Tax Code Accounting Field
tools.description: Tool to delete the tax code accounting field from Ramp. Use when you need to remove the tax code field configuration. Note: The tax code field must exist before deletion.

tools.name: Delete Accounting Tax Code Option
tools.description: Tool to delete a tax code option from Ramp. Use when you need to remove a tax code option from the accounting system.

tools.name: Delete Accounting Tax Rate
tools.description: Tool to delete an accounting tax rate from Ramp. Use when you need to remove a tax rate from the accounting system.

tools.name: Delete Accounting Vendor

description: Payment gateway and financial services platform for businesses in India

tools.name: Cancel Invoice

tools.name: Cancel Payment Link
tools.description: Tool to cancel a specific payment link. Use when you need to cancel an active payment link before it expires. The payment link cannot be used after cancellation.

tools.name: Create an Order
tools.description: Tool to create a Razorpay order with specified amount and currency. Use when you need to initiate a payment order before collecting payment from a customer. Amount and currency are mandatory parameters; receipt and notes are optional for internal tracking.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Tool to create a contact for payouts in RazorpayX. Use when you need to add a new contact (employee, vendor, or customer) for making payouts.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Tool to create a new customer in Razorpay. Use when you need to register a customer for recurring payments or saved cards. Returns a customer_id that can be used for future transactions.

tools.name: Create an Invoice
tools.description: Tool to create an invoice for billing customers. Use when you need to generate an invoice with customer details and line items. You can create a blank invoice in draft state, update it later, and issue it when ready.

tools.name: Create Item
tools.description: Tool to create an item that can be used in Razorpay invoices. Use when you need to create a new product or service entry for invoicing purposes.

tools.name: Create Payment Link
tools.description: Tool to create a payment link for collecting payments via a shareable URL. Use when you need to generate a payment link for a customer to complete payment online.

tools.name: Delete Invoice
tools.description: Tool to delete an invoice in Razorpay. Use when you need to permanently remove an invoice from the system. Note: Only invoices in 'draft' status can be deleted. Invoices in other statuses (issued, paid, cancelled) cannot be deleted.

tools.name: Delete item
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing item from Razorpay. Use when you need to permanently remove an item from the system. Items can only be deleted if they are not associated with any invoices.

tools.name: Fetch All Customers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all customers from Razorpay. Use when you need to get customer details for multiple customers or iterate through the customer base.

tools.name: Fetch All Invoices
tools.description: Tool to fetch all invoices with pagination and filtering support. Use when you need to retrieve a list of invoices, optionally filtered by payment ID, customer ID, receipt, or date range.

tools.name: Fetch All Payment Links
tools.description: Tool to fetch all payment links with pagination and filtering support. Use when you need to retrieve a list of payment links, optionally filtered by payment ID, reference ID, or date range.

tools.name: Fetch All Payments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all payments from your Razorpay account with pagination and time filtering support. Use when you need to list payments, audit transactions, or analyze payment history. Returns payments in descending order by creation time (newest first).

tools.name: Fetch all refunds for a payment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all refunds for a specific payment using the Razorpay API. Use when you need to check refund status, track refund history, or list all refunds associated with a particular payment.

tools.name: Fetch a Payment Link
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific payment link by its ID. Use when you need to check the status, amount, customer details, or other attributes of an existing payment link.

tools.name: Fetch Invoice by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch a specific invoice by its ID from Razorpay. Use when you need to retrieve complete details of an invoice including customer information, line items, amounts, and payment status.

tools.name: Fetch All Orders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all orders from Razorpay. Use when you need to fetch multiple orders, filter by date range, receipt, or authorization status.

tools.name: Fetch Order by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch details of a specific Razorpay order using its order ID. Use when you need to retrieve order information, check order status, or verify payment details.

tools.name: Fetch payments by order
tools.description: Tool to fetch all payments made for a particular order. Use when you need to retrieve payment details associated with a specific order ID.

tools.name: Fetch All Refunds
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all refunds created by you using the Razorpay API. Use when you need to list refunds, track refund status, or analyze refund history with pagination support.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific contact by ID in RazorpayX. Use when you need to fetch information about an existing contact including their name, email, contact details, and metadata.

tools.name: Retrieve Customer
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific customer by their ID. Use when you need to fetch customer information including name, email, contact details, and custom notes.

tools.name: Get Fund Account
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific fund account by its ID. Use when you need to fetch fund account information including associated contact, account type, and payment details.

tools.name: Get Item
tools.description: Tool to retrieve complete details of a specific Razorpay item by its ID. Use when you need to fetch information about an item including its name, description, amount, tax details, and other metadata.

tools.name: Get Settlement Reconciliation Report
tools.description: Tool to fetch settlement reconciliation report for a specific date or month from Razorpay. Use when you need to retrieve detailed settlement transaction data for accounting and reconciliation purposes.

tools.name: Get Transfer Reversals
tools.description: Tool to fetch all reversals for a specific transfer using the Razorpay Route API. Use when you need to check reversal status, track reversal history, or list all reversals associated with a particular transfer.

tools.name: Issue an Invoice
tools.description: Tool to issue a draft Razorpay invoice to send it to the customer. Use when you need to issue an invoice that has been created in draft status. Only invoices in 'draft' status can be issued.

tools.name: List Customer Tokens
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all tokens (saved payment methods) for a customer. Use when you need to fetch the list of saved payment methods associated with a specific customer ID.

tools.name: List Disputes

tools.name: List Fund Accounts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all fund accounts from RazorpayX with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch payout destinations, view beneficiary accounts, or manage fund account records. Supports filtering by contact and account type for efficient retrieval.

tools.name: List Fund Validations
tools.description: Tool to fetch all fund account validation transactions from RazorpayX with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve validation records, check account verification status, or monitor validation transactions.

tools.name: List Items
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all items from Razorpay with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch invoice items, view available products, or manage item catalog. Supports filtering by active status and date range for efficient retrieval.

tools.name: List Payment Downtimes
tools.description: Tool to fetch all active payment method downtimes from Razorpay. Use when you need to check the current status of payment methods and identify any ongoing or scheduled downtimes.

tools.name: Notify Payment Link
tools.description: Tool to send or resend notification for a payment link via SMS or email. Use when you need to notify a customer about a payment link.

tools.name: Send/Resend Invoice Notification
tools.description: Tool to send or resend an invoice notification via email or SMS. Use when you need to notify customers about an invoice through their preferred communication channel.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Tool to update an existing contact's details in RazorpayX. Use when you need to modify contact information such as name, email, phone number, type, reference ID, or notes.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Tool to update an existing customer's details in Razorpay. Use when you need to modify customer information such as name, email, or contact number.

tools.name: Update Invoice
tools.description: Tool to update an existing draft invoice in Razorpay. Use when you need to modify invoice details such as customer information, line items, description, notes, or other fields. Only invoices in draft state can be updated.

tools.description: Tool to update an existing item's details in Razorpay. Use when you need to modify the name, description, or amount of an item. Only the fields provided in the request will be updated; other fields remain unchanged.
